listings.title: Apartment in Santa Maria Maior
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Lisbon, Portugal
listings.description:
Tuck away up to 5th floor spacious penthouse with bird's eye views. Redecorated, aircon, tons of sunlight & views. Stay in heart of historical district in central Bairro Alto/Chiado. Two Balconies! Huge lounge, two bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen, office Desk, optic fiber. Steps to Baixa, Principe Real and transport system. Lively Area w.Restaurants, Music, Fado, Nightlife. Ideal for friends, couples, business travelers. NO ELEVATOR.Not suitable for people with mobility issues or children

The space
5th flr penthouse with bird's eye views. Sleeps up to four comfortably with privacy. Huge lounge, two bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen with laundry machine and dishwasher, bathroom with bathtub/shower, two balconies with East + West exposures. Direct, unobstructed views over Lisbon rooftops and Tagus river from all rooms! Wooden shutters in bedrooms to Block Sunlight and silent AC units for complete confort. Redecorated! Spacious Rooms, Amazing Views + Central Location. 

5th Floor with no elevator, so even it is a wide and easy to climb stairwell, not suitable for guests with mobility issues.

Heart of Historical Center! Bairro Alto/Chiado, steps to Baixa. Charming, vibrant and lively area. The apartment couldn’t be more ideal for exploring this great city, walkable with convenient train and bus stations nearby. For COUPLES - two large bedrooms with storage and separated with plenty of privacy. For FRIENDS - apartment sleeps up to four people with privacy. For FAMILY - Fully equipped kitchen to cook, washing machine, dishwasher, easy convenient location. NOT ADVISED FOR SMALL CHILDREN due to potencial noise. For BUSINESS travelers - Fast Wi-Fi Internet, Office Desk, Central location, close to Business Districts. In walking distance to main historical sites: 
* Famous Historical Central Area Bairro Alto
* Shopping, Luxury District of Chiado
* Praça de Luís de Camões (Downtown Central Square)
* Shopping Street Principe Real with Garden & Park
* Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara (Famous Viewpoint)
* Igreja de São Roque (Famous Church)
* Cais do Sodre (Pink Street, Nightlife, Clubs, Bars)
*Mercado da Ribeira (Time Out Market)
*Rossio Square (day trip to Sintra) 
* Praça do Comercio
* Praça da Figueira (Tram 15 to Belem) 
* City Castle (São Jorge Castle) 
* Famous tram No. 28 
* Metro, Bus Station, Taxi Square 
* Supermarkets
* Tourism office

Guest access
Find comfort and convenience with friends, family or business travelers. What makes this apartment so special is a super central location, newly redecorated with style, and unobstructed views through large windows, doors and balconies over Lisbon and the Tagus River. The views and light are simply spectacular. You will feel at home in this space and find all the furniture and amenities for you to relax after a long day exploring the city. Inside the apartment we supply:
* fresh towels/linens
* free hi-speed wifi
* hairdryer
* 45" flat screen HD TV w.Cable, Netflix, YouTube access
*office desk

Kitchen:
* dishwasher
* oven
* coffee/tea
* toaster 
* microwave
* washing machine

We strive to supply all the essentials for you to have the most comfortable stay in this incredible city. If there is anything you might need during your stay, please don’t hesitate to ask and we will do out best to provide it.

Other things to note
Directions to Apartment:
* TAXI – About 20 min from airport, 15-20€ (Tell driver Igreja da Sao Roque in Bairro Alto. From church 1 min walk on Tv. da Queimada left to Rua do Norte 
* SUBWAY – About 40 min from airport. Red Line from the airport, change to Green Line at "Alameda" station. Exit ”Baixa-Chiado" station. Apt is 8 min walk. 
* All Guests will receive an e-mail, before the check-in, with all information regarding arrival. Most days you will be personally greeted by host, in rare cases where we cannot meet, will drop by later. Always available by Mobile or Email.

listings.name: Heart of Lisbon modern apartment
listings.title: Apartment in Misericórdia
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Lisbon, Portugal
listings.description:
The space
The apartment is located in a modern building in the Bairro Alto district, one of the oldest neighborhoods of Lisbon, where you will be able to enjoy most of Lisbon's attractions by foot and surely combine comfort and elegance with the experience of the traditional Portuguese way of life. It is a place where you will certainly feel like being part of a sophisticated atmosphere in Lisbon.

The apartment

The apartment is high standard, located in a second floor with an elevator, and includes one bedroom, a living room with one double sofa bed, a complete kitchen with a balcony with all you need and a bathroom. 

The supermarket is just down the street of the apartment, and there are great restaurants, bakeries, small groceries and cafés in the area, as well as a pharmacy.

Amenities:

Bed room: 2 single bed (suitable for a couple or 2 friends);
Living room: 1 double sofa bed;
Sheets and bath towels included;
Air conditioning, central heating, refrigerator, freezer, dish washer, cooking stove, oven, microwave, coffee maker, toaster, kettle, bidet, baby cot, baby high chair (upon request), books, Iron, small Ironing board, hairdryer, Cable TV.

The apartment includes INTERNET with wireless router and unlimited use. The internet service is fiber high speed suitable for working and streaming.

We are available to help you with everything you need to know about Lisbon and the apartment and provide you with local hints and tips for perfect holidays.

Location

A lively cobblestone street populated with small traditional and inventive restaurants, fado houses and trendy entrepreneur pop-up studios, the hip neighborhood of Bairro Alto dates back to the 16th century and is as central as it is different from anything else.

In the past, it was home to artists and bohemians. Perched on the most emblematic of Lisbon’s hills, tucked between the uber chic Chiado and the elegant Principe Real, Bairro Alto offers a unique experience in the Lisbon life, Cruising through its narrow streets, witnessing the chameleon-like life, between the traditional local shops, chatting neighbors, to trendy restaurants, design shops and alternative fashion pop-ups.

Chiado is considered the most beautiful area of historic Lisbon. It was a place of residence of the Portuguese royalty and of the political and cultural elite. Nearby are located the theatre Sao Luis and the opera Sao Carlos. A little further is Camões Square (Praça de Camões), next to Bairro Alto, picturesque but raffish. Part of Lisbon's nightlife is concentrated in this quarter, where you can hear 'fados' being sung in some restaurants and cafés. Chiado and Bairro Alto are where locals and tourists meet, with elegant hotels, old cafés and the best international fashion shops.

The apartment is a short walking distance from the other picturesque neighbourhoods of Baixa and Alfama, where you can find the historic Castle (Sao Jorge). It is also walking distance to the subway and train stations that can take you to the beautiful beaches around Cascais.

Transports

The area is really well served with public transportation:

METRO (450m) – Lisbon metro Baixa/Chiado station (blue and green lines) is about 5 minutes walking from the apartment. From there you can go comfortably to everywhere in the city.

TAXIS (350m) – a taxi station in Chiado is less than 5 minutes walking.

TRAM - the famous tram 28 that runs through Lisbon picturesque city center has a stop just down the street of the apartment.

CASCAIS TRAIN LINE (Cais do Sodré station 900m) – the Cascais line that takes you to “Belem” and the beautiful beaches of Estoril and Cascais is just a 10 minute walk from the apartment.

SINTRA TRAIN LINE (Rossio station 850m) – also just a 10 minute walk from the apartment is Rossio station where you have the line that takes you to Sintra, considered World Heritage Site by UNESCO and a must see place.

LISBON INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (9 km) - We recommend a taxi to go to the apartment from the airport and it costs about 10€ to 12€ (and it takes 4 persons or more depending on the type of car).

PARKING - there are three public car parks within 3 minutes walking distance. In the center of Lisbon parking has always a cost.

listings.name: Bright & Stylish Renovated Flat in Heart of Chiado
listings.title: Apartment in Santa Maria Maior
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Lisbon, Portugal
listings.description:
Wake up in the heart of Chiado, in a brand-new apartment finished in July 2026. Full renovation led by an interior designer, bright interiors, and top-end finishes throughout, the kind of place that feels calm the moment you walk in.

The space
Light pours in through windows opening onto a small Juliet balcony over the calm Oliveira ao Carmo street. 

The open-plan living and dining area combines a sofa, a dining space for two, and a fully equipped SMEG kitchen with dishwasher, oven, and Nespresso machine.

Sleep is a priority here: a hotel-quality 160x200 bed with quality linens, and a calm, minimalist palette, right next to a ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower.

A NOTE ON THE STAIRS
The apartment is on the third floor of a classic Lisbon building with no elevator and a narrow staircase: pack light and you'll be fine. It's the trade-off that comes with a genuinely central, characterful address, and it's the same layout you'll find throughout this part of Chiado.

WHAT YOU GET
High-speed wifi and a dedicated workspace built for remote work. Smart TV. Independent air conditioning and heating in both the living room and bedroom. Smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm, and a first aid kit are all in place. 

THE LOCATION
Chiado is central Lisbon at its finest, and you're right in the middle of it! You can walk to the main sights, and step out your door into some of the city's best cafés and shops. 

The Baixa-Chiado metro is a 5-minute walk, Bairro Alto and its tram 28 stop are 2 minutes away, and it's an easy 10-minute walk down to Praça do Comércio and the river. The airport is roughly 15–20 minutes away by taxi.

Guest access
Guests have full and private access to the apartment for the whole stay.

The space
About the house: it's a bright and airy 115 sqm two-bedroom apartment in the 1st floor of a modern building with lift and private underground garage. Large windows and four juliet balconies offer a view of the famous 28 tram trundling up the street with the Tejo River in the distance. 
It's ideal for up to 4 people.

Linen and towels are provided. Kitchen is well equipped with nespresso machine, toaster, electric jug, microwave, dishwasher, washing machine with dryer, etc. Basics to cook like olive oil, vinegar, salt and sugar are also available. There is an iron and ironing board as well. 

In the bathrooms, you’ll find a hair dryer, toilet paper, shower gel and shampoo.

You are also free to use the building's large communal terrace.

Transfers between the airport and the apartment are an extra service - please let us know if are interested.

In the heart of Bairro Alto, a charming apartment in a modern building with a lift. Bairro Alto buzzes with bars and restaurants that, on weekends, can continue until 5 am. It is not a quiet neighborhood. If you are looking for a tranquil corner of town, this is not the place for you. The apartment is spacious with a bedroom featuring a 160x200 bed, a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom, and a spacious living room with a comfortable sofa. The double-glazed windows help provide quietness at night.

The space
Welcome to our charming apartment located in the heart of Bairro Alto. This space presents a fusion of modern and classic styles, highlighted by the recently renovated kitchen, which gives a contemporary touch to the rest of the apartment, characterized by its more classic atmosphere. The fully equipped kitchen has a washing machine and dishwasher, providing complete freedom to prepare your meals.

The bathroom offers convenience with a bathtub, and the bedroom is equipped with a large bed measuring 160X200. Bairro Alto is famous for its lively nightlife, and this apartment is situated in the epicenter of all the action. If you are looking for a peaceful environment, this is not the ideal place for you. However, if you are looking for an incredibly well-located space, with countless bars and restaurants within walking distance, this is, without a doubt, the perfect place for you.

Guest access

Other things to note
This is a lively neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bars that on weekends can go until late. If you are after a quiet area this is not the place for you.

Personal data will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation, Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament. In this sense, the necessary measures will be taken to avoid alteration, loss, treatment, or unauthorized access.

The apartment is located in a restricted area, so it isn't possible to go with the car to the building. You should park outside the neighborhood.

No parties or other events are allowed. Smoking is not permitted, even by the window. Pets are not allowed.

listings.name: Casas de SantAna - Old town river views
listings.title: Apartment in Porto
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Porto, Portugal
listings.description:
The apartment is located in the historic center of Porto, World Heritage of UNESCO, in the oldest street of the city. Is part of a building with 4 dwellings rehabilitated in June 2017.

The space
The apartment is approximately 55m2 and is located on the 2nd floor without an elevator. It is equipped with a queen size bed in the bedroom and a sofa with two single beds in the living room, a bathroom and kitchen fully equipped. The bathroom is in the bedroom. Ideal for two to four people.
The living room offers a small balcony with views of the Douro River.
The location is privileged to discover the historic center of Porto on foot. Just a few meters are two of the most beautiful sights of the city. If you prefer to use the metro, the station of S. Bento is just 5 minutes away. At the same distance, going down towards the Douro River, you will be in Ribeira, and crossing the bridge D. Luiz you can visit the Oporto wine cellars. 
Nearby there are several monuments to visit, such as Palácio da Bolsa, Casa do Infante, São Francisco church and Torre dos Clérigos, all less than 10 minutes away.
In the center, there is a huge variety of bars and typical Portuguese restaurants to choose from, so you can find the various options, from simple and traditional to the most sophisticated and contemporary.
By bus or tram you can easily reach the beaches of Foz.
For nightlife, we recommend the Galerias de Paris Street which is a 10 min walk in uptown.

Guest access
The apartment is on the 2nd floor without an elevator.
Access is done with a code.
Our street is very leaned, as the rest of the city. Be prepared to do some gimnastic!
Please note that access to the street by car is limited to residents.

Other things to note
- In the neighborhood live local, genuine Porto people. Be prepared to listen to Fado and Portuguese music during the day.
- Electronic Complaints Book Available
- For your information there is a motion detector alarm/intrusion alarm in the livingroom, next to the entrance door. It’s not a camera or a recording device. We turn it on when we don’t have guests and it’s for the security of the apartment.

listings.name: Porto Traditional Lifestyle
listings.title: Home in Porto
listings.headline: Entire home in Porto, Portugal
listings.description:
Is a secular house with granite stonework and the typical colors of the neighborhood and is located in the historic center of Porto.
It was totally restored by an architect of the Porto chamber keeping the old moth.
The decoration is based on family pieces carefully collected and restored by me containing objects from various periods.
The objective was to preserve as possible the way of life of the Porto residents and in every corner of the house will feel and appreciate their personality.

The space
The house, with its granite stonework and typical colors, is located in the historic center of Porto.
It was completely restored by an architect from the Porto City Council, maintaining its original design.
Recently, without altering the original frame, we were able to install new thermal and acoustic windows, making the house much quieter and more comfortable.
The decor is based on family heirlooms, carefully collected and restored by me, containing objects from various eras. However, the appliances are new except for the stovetop and electric oven. The beds are regular size (150x190). The goal
was to preserve as much as possible the Porto way of life, and in every corner of the house, guests will feel and appreciate its personality.
The house has no other dwellings; it is a detached house with no neighbors above or below, and guests do not encounter other neighbors.
This ensures maximum social distancing safety.

Other things to note
Due to Covid 19, the house will be disinfected with anti-bacterial products and people who will clean between check-in's will wear gowns, masks, visors and gloves.
guests will have cleaning products and toiletries at their disposal.

Rua Corpo da Guarda- São Bento/Sé
Newly refurbished apartment located in one of the oldest neighborhoods in Porto: Sé. The apartment is located in a calm street but near all the main attractions of Porto. It is close to bakeries, grocery stores, pharmacies and within a walking distance to the iconic S. Bento train station, the Clérigos Tower, the famous Lello Bookshop, and also typical restaurants, hype bars and cafes.

The space
Offering a balcony with a view to S. Bento train staiton, the units feature air conditioning, a living room area, with a cable flat-screen TV and full equipped kitchen.

Entering the apartment there is the kitchenette and the living room in an open space where we have a sofa and a table where meals can be served. 

In the kitchenette you can find all the necessary utensils for making a meal (various pots, pans, dishes, etc.) and a kettle to serve tea, and things to make coffee and tea. 

At the living room a comfy soft couch to relax and enjoy some TV after a day exploring the city. The big windows makes this apartment bright with a lot of natural light and you still get the view of hills of Porto's historical centre.

On your bedroom, a comfortable double size bed and wardrobes to store your clothes. We also provide fresh cotton towels and bedding, as well as a choice of pillows.

In the bathroom you can find shower gel & Shampoo and also hand soap.

We have carefully prepared the apartment to make you feel comfortable and at home, so you can totally relax when you return from your daily exploring.

➤ Full equipped kitchenette with ceramic hob, microwave, fridge and freezer, kettle, toaster, cookware, tableware, utensils, kitchen essentials and bins;

listings.title: Condo in 15th Arrondissement
listings.headline: Entire condo in 15th Arrondissement, France
listings.description:
Large Studio, as a Suite, ideally located
in a quiet street, close to the Eiffel Tower and 2 minutes away from La Motte Piquet Grenelle metro station. Many restaurants around too!
The apartment is fully equipped with all you may need for a few days (soap, shampoo, hair dryer, toilet paper ...).
Perfect for a couple with the main room being quite spacious, and convenient for 2 people wishing separate beds (sofa will be converted into a single bed).

The space
Charming studio, decorated with light colors and all the equipment needed. Small kitchen, large shower, comfortable queen size bed, large secured window viewing the small street without being seen (!), 2 small windows to be opened at any time, a refresher system (2 efficient fans) for cooler nights at summer time.
A mirror film covers the large window to allow your privacy during daytime, as long as lights are not turned on, but if so, you shall wish to close the thick curtains :)
The Shower is spacious with very hot water coming from a water tank sized for 2 people; you may however be careful, if letting hot water run continuously for several minutes, or you (or the next person to shower) may be running out of hot water; it shall take about 2 hours before the water tank gets very warm again.
Be careful when using the cooking plates; you shall just avoid using - at the same time! - one of the 3 devices on the cupboard or the electricity may shut down... no worry, the main electrical switch in the cupboard near the entrance door can be turned to 0 and back on I to get the electricity back on :)

Guest access
The studio is dedicated to you! It is located at the ground floor, accessible after 2 secured entrance doors, in a quiet and secured area (Military school, Eiffel Tower and Administration Offices around). I will be happy welcoming you (most of the time unless being away from Paris) but you shall be able to self check in too (if facing major delays or in case of later check in until 1:00am).

Other things to note
The apartment is not equipped for a baby or young child and little steps to access the kitchen or shower room may not be adapted for the youngest but the pea bed can be converted at during night time to allow a young child to sleep in. 

The apartment window is covered by a mirror film that allows you to keep your privacy during day time but you shall close the curtains when it's getting dark outside or when all the lights are turned on inside to keep your privacy!

In case you'd need to leave your luggages somewhere before checking in or after checking out, you may wish to go to Montparnasse train station (just 4 metro stops from La Motte Piquet Grenelle metro station) as you'll find lockers there.

Stay in a stylish Central London Zone 1 flat, shared only with me, Adriana, and no other guests. 2 minutes walk from Nine Elms Tube/Metro/Subway, 7–10 minutes walk to the US Embassy & Sky Pool, 2 stops from Big Ben and the London Eye. You’ll have a private bedroom with a key lock, plus free parking — a rare Zone 1 bonus. I stay in a separate room. Towels, bed linen, bathrobes, slippers, shampoo, and shower gel are provided. Not suitable for children under 6.

The space
This is a characterful 1940s apartment block with a lift, located in Central London. The kitchen and living room retain their original glass doors and classic charm, giving the flat warmth and personality.

The private guest room has both double glazing and secondary glazing to help reduce city noise. The bedroom door also has a key lock for extra privacy and peace of mind.

Guest access
Guests have access to the whole flat apart of my private room.

Please note the kitchen is for light use only, for breakfast. It is ideal for toast, muesli, tea, coffee, and simple cold meals or snacks. A microwave and fridge is available.

Parking is available by request—just send me your car make, model, number plate, and estimated arrival time, and I’ll make sure everything is ready for you.

During your stay
I’m always happy to help! Feel free to message me on Airbnb at any time, or call if something’s urgent—I’ll do my best to respond promptly and make sure you feel right at home.

Other things to note
LUGGAGE
If you’d like to drop off luggage before check-in, just message me in advance. I can usually accommodate this (about 99% of the time!), unless I have a prior appointment I can’t reschedule.

⸻

PARKING

If you need to leave your car after checkout, I’ll do my best to accommodate that too—as long as there’s no new guest arriving with a car, you can usually leave it until the end of the day. If another guest does need the space, I’ll let you know and kindly ask you to move the car.

⸻

⸻

LAUNDRY

Location couldn't be better. Off a secluded side street by Leicester Square, just steps from Soho, The West End, and Trafalgar Square, and with excellent transport links – book with us and maximise your time in London.

The space
Discover the perfect blend of historic charm and modern comfort. The elegant oak floors and classic wall panelling set a sophisticated tone, complemented by tasteful and inviting touches throughout. Stay connected with the fastest internet in London, backed by a secondary line for uninterrupted connectivity. A spacious desk area is ready for your work needs.

Unwind on the large, opulent UK King bed with a memory foam orthopaedic mattress and premium hotel-quality linens, ensuring a restful night's sleep. The bathroom offers a generous raindrop shower, soft white towels, and high-quality toiletries.

The well-appointed kitchenette includes a sizeable fridge with a separate freezer, kettle, toaster, hob, and a Nespresso machine. Enjoy pure, fresh water from the built-in filtration system, and take advantage of the shared laundry room (shared with only two other guest studios).

Professionally cleaned before your arrival, the property provides a hotel-standard linen service and operates entirely on renewable energy, ensuring an eco-friendly stay. For larger groups, this is also one of three apartments available in this historic building, allowing the possibility of reserving more than one unit, subject to availability.

Located on the second floor (3rd storey) with around 27 steps to the property, this apartment sits in vibrant Soho, surrounded by stylish restaurants and bustling nightlife. Piccadilly Circus Station is just a 1-minute walk away, and Charing Cross Rail Station is a less than a five minute walk. Iconic sites like Covent Garden, Oxford Street, the West End, Buckingham Palace, and the Southbank are all within easy strolling distance, making this the perfect location to explore London!  Seize the opportunity to stay in this unique blend of history and modern luxury. Book now for an unforgettable London experience, surrounded by charm, convenience, and style!

Guest access
Please note that the building is nearly 300 years old, with some quirks, such as uneven stairs which may be a challenge for guests with significant mobility-impairment. 

Guests enjoy exclusive access to the entire property.

Check-in is both easy and flexible thanks to a keysafe, meaning you can access the apartment immediately and make the most of your time in London.

Other things to note
The apartment is on the 2nd floor with no lift, so the approx 27 steps offer a bit of exercise to offset some London’s culinary indulgence! The building is nearly 300 years old, with some quirks and the steps are sometimes uneven, but the apartment has been fully modernised this year. Heritage England would not allow AC to be fitted because of the building’s historical significance, but the building stays cool naturally and we have large fans for warmer days. Pets (as much as we love them), parties and smoking are not allowed. While the location is quieter and we have soundproofing, some city noise may still be present. The “UK King” bed is equivalent to an “American Queen”. There is also one step between the bedroom area and the kitchen.

Lovely and bright garden flat right in the heart of Chelsea perfectly located next to trendy shops, bars, restaurants, gyms, cinemas, supermarkets and great transport - 10 min walk to Earl's Court Road station(or a couple of stops on the bus). Great location to the Kings Road, Hollywood Road and close to Hyde park & Battersea Park.

The flat has a king bed in the bedroom with skylights, and a sofa-bed in the living room (available on request for two guests), with a view towards the patio/garden.

The space
The flat is modern, bright, quiet, well-insulated, and the sofa in the living room can be converted to a small double sofa bed suitable for 1 adult or 2 children (please see photos for size of sofabed). The flat is suitable for up to 4 guests, and is fully kitted out with TV, fast WiFi, all kitchen stuff, a dishwasher, a large fridge/freezer and a washer/drier machine.

You can also enjoy the private patio/garden in the back :) The flat faces away from the street so it's pleasantly quiet. In addition, even though the flat is located on the lower ground floor, you can enjoy plenty of natural light due to the skylight windows. Please note, you will have to climb stairs - there are 7-8 steps down from street level.

Location & nearby attractions

The apartment is set in a prime Chelsea location, surrounded by cafés, restaurants, shops, gyms, cinemas and supermarkets.

- King’s Road and Hollywood Road, 5–10 minutes walk
King’s Road is one of London’s most iconic streets, known for its fashionable boutiques, stylish cafés and vibrant Chelsea atmosphere.
Hollywood Road is a charming and elegant street, famous for its antique shops, interior design studios and relaxed, local feel.

Recommended cafés & restaurants nearby:

- Bluebird Chelsea – popular for brunch, lunch and cocktails
- The Ivy Chelsea Garden – stylish all day dining in a beautiful garden setting
- Medlar – Michelin starred, perfect for a special evening
- The Good Life Eatery – healthy breakfasts, smoothies and coffee
- GAIL’s Bakery – great coffee, pastries and fresh bread

Getting around & attractions:

- Earl’s Court Underground Station, around 10 minutes walk
- Stamford Bridge (Chelsea FC Stadium), around 13 minutes walk
- Hyde Park and Harrods, around 25 minutes by public transport
- Natural History Museum and Victoria and Albert Museum, around 20 minutes by tube
- Buckingham Palace, Kensington Palace, Piccadilly Circus and Covent Garden, around 30 minutes by public transport

With excellent transport connections, the flat offers easy access to central London and Heathrow Airport, making it an ideal base for sightseeing, business trips or longer stays.

Guest access
The whole flat is yours! Guest must walk down 7-8 stairs to get to the flat.

Other things to note
Please note, you will have to climb stairs - there are 7-8 steps down from street level to get to the flat.

No smoking inside the property - £200 fine.
Keep the noise down after 10pm and no parties at the property - £200 fine
Do not rearrange the furniture, please.

The standard cleaning fee for 2 guests includes linen and towels for 1 bed only - anything additional can be provided on request but will incur an extra charge of £25 to cover the extra linen costs.

listings.name: Notting Hill - The One One One! (6)
listings.title: Apartment in London
listings.headline: Entire serviced apartment in Greater London, United Kingdom
listings.description:
Welcome to this spacious and stylish apartment in a beautiful renovated Victorian conversion. You'll be in a superb location for the very best of Notting Hill, just one minute walk from Ladbroke Grove Tube (Circle, District and Hammersmith lines) and a two minute stroll to the renowned Portobello Road with all its shops, cafes, bars and restaurants. The apartment is quiet and equipped with everything you'll need for a fabulous stay.

Carnival 29-31 August? Message first for details.

The space
Due to the raised mezzanine bedroom area this studio feels super spacious. Entering through your private hallway you’ll find a fully equipped kitchen including dishwasher and washer/dryer and a comfy sofa in the living area with a 42" Android smart TV for those evenings in. There is a large bathroom below the bedroom area with a full size bath with shower, complimentary eco shower gel and shampoo and fluffy towels for you too.

Up the stairs a super comfy king size bed awaits you and with 400 thread count Egyptian pure cotton bedding and puffy pillows you won't want to get out of it! Useful bedside wireless phone chargers ensure your phone is fully charged in the morning, ready capture photos of the local multi coloured Notting Hill houses.

To make sure you stay connected there is super fast wireless WIFI throughout this apartment with a quick connect QR code for your convenience.

We are located right next door to the famous Sarm recording studios (now Threesixzero) where stars such as Rihanna, One Direction, Kanye West, Dua Lipa and Kylie Minogue to name but a few have all recorded, so don’t be surprised if you bump into someone famous on your way to the multitude of bars & restaurants Notting Hill has to offer. For shopping, if Portobello market doesn't have what you need then the huge Westfield shopping centre is just two tube stops (4 mins) away.

Guest access
All keyless access to the front door and the separate apartment door.
Codes sent two days prior to arrival.
Guests will have access to the whole apartment during their stay.

Other things to note
Although higher than most similar mezzanines, there is a restricted 1.5m height (5ft) in the upstairs bedroom area. This may not suit anyone with back or mobilty issues. The apartment is at the back of the building so is quiet.

Standard check-in time is 3pm onwards, and check-out time is before 11am.

***Hot water is from an electric immersion tank and although usually sufficient for 2 guests to shower, if long showers or baths are taken it may take an hour for the tank to heat the water up again***
There is a non slip shower mat located in the bathroom vanity unit. We recommend using this when taking a shower.

*** The One One One is a strictly no smoking building. As well as tobacco this includes vapes, incense sticks etc. There is a £100 cleaning surcharge for failure to adhere to this policy.

*** If your reservation is for two people but you would like the single bed made up there is a £35 supplement and you should request this a minimum 24 hours in advance as linen is not stored in the apartment. 
For bookings of three people this is included in the price and will be automatically set up for you.

Studio apartment with own entrance in quiet Kensington street. The studio has an en suite bathroom, an en suite kitchenette and access to a small garden area. It is located within a few minutes walk of shops, restaurants, Kensington Palace Gardens (Hyde Park). High Street Kensington tube station 7 minutes walk and 10 minute walk to Gloucester Road tube station.
Parking is available and chargeable at £20/night, please pay host directly at check in.

The space
Please let me know at the time of booking if you require parking. 

Located in one of Kensington's prime residential areas. Quiet but within 5 minutes walk of bars, restaurants, shops and public transport.

WHAT WE PROVIDE: 
1. COVID-19 SPECIAL: We provide anti-bacterial soap, anti-bac disinfectant plant-based spray, suitable for all hard surfaces and hand sanitiser. 
We change mattress and pillow protectors and steam mattress after every booking. 

CONTACT-FREE ENTRY – We provide a contact-free access to the studio with a lock box located just outside the entrance and check in support via video doorbell. 

FAST BROADBAND - Virgin wi-fi with strong even signal throughout the studio. 

SMART TV & NETFLIX - Sony TV with Roku box. All live terrestrial channels such as BBC, Sky, ITV, Channel 4, 5, Film 4, etc accessible via TV Player App, individual apps for on demand TV, Netflix, Amazon Prime and other streaming apps also available;

FULLY EQUIPPED KITCHEN - here you will find a Nespresso coffee machine with recyclable coffee pods, induction hob, microwave/ oven, kettle, sandwich grill, fridge and blender. We provide tea, coffee, herbal teas and basic cooking condiments, spices & herbs;

COMFORTABLE BED: The 200cm x 220 cm (UK super king /US king) pocketspring mattress has a goose down and feather mattress topper, and hotel quality bedlinen (our guests always highlight how comfortable the bed is!) 

ROOM DARKENING BLINDS to ensure a good night’s sleep;

SMART HEATING - is regulated with Honeywell thermostat so we make sure the studio is nice and warm but saving energy at the same time;

CHARGERS AND ADAPTERS – A triple USB charger and adapters are provided. 

VEGAN FRIENDLY TOILETRIES - our shower gel, hand soap and hand lotion are from my son’s New York based scent company, Olfactory NYC , all in recyclable bottles. All products are cruelty free and not tested on animals;

SUMMER COOLING – The studio is equipped with a portable air conditioner ( for the 2-3 days a year that it is needed!) and a stand up fan. 

BOOKS & MAGAZINES – for your enjoyment;

OTHER THINGS WE PROVIDE: 
•Toilet roll;
•Paper towels;
•Hairdryers;
•Iron & ironing board;
•Eco-friendly recycled fabric shopping bags to save you 10p every time you shop;
•Umbrella – please remember to leave those for next guests;
Bath robes;
Emergency toiletry kits. 

Guest access
Entire studio is solely for guest use.
NEW COVID-19 ACCESS ARRANGEMENTS: 
For the safety of our guests and cleaning staff we block 24hrs between bookings to comply with new regulations for hosts who conform to Airbnb Enhanced Cleaning Routines. 
CHECK IN: Full access from 2pm min 24hrs after last guests checkout. 

EARLY CHECK IN: Please contact me if you require an early check in. It is usually possible to accommodate early check ins. 

LUGGAGE DROP OFF: FREE Luggage drop off on the day of arrival, however if the cleaner is still inside, please let the cleaner wheel in the luggage. Please do not come in when the cleaners are in. 

LATE CHECK OUTS - May be arranged ONLY if next guests are arriving 24hrs after your departure.

BAG STORAGE ON DEPARTURE - you can leave your bags until your departure by the door inside the apartment. Once you have packed and left luggage for the day, please do not use the studio after 11am so that we can comply with 24hrs buffer between bookings. 
Alternatively we recommend Bag BnB which charges £5 per bag for whole day and stores are all over London. We will send you the link once you book.

COVID-19 ADDITIONAL HYGIENE & SAFETY: 
For your own protection, please wipe your luggage with anti-bacterial wipes (provided) before bringing it into the apartment. 
Hand sanitizer will be provided by the door at the entrance. Please use every time you enter the apartment.
Shoes must be left inside by studio entrance. Please do not walk in shoes inside the studio please.

Enjoy a magical stay in this newly refurbished 2-bedroom flat featuring a bright living room, a fully equipped modern kitchen, and a private decked garden softly lit for cosy evenings. As you step inside, you're welcomed into a thoughtfully arranged living room, curated for your utmost comfort. Sink into the inviting sofa and unwind while enjoying entertainment on the TV or stay connected with high-speed Wi-Fi. A delightful breakfast nook and a charming dining area for four set the stage for memorable meals and intimate gatherings.

Through the expansive glass doors lies the pièce de résistance – the private decked garden. Fully furnished with two dining/rest areas for four, it beckons you to indulge in al fresco dining or simply relax amidst the tranquil ambiance.

The separate kitchen is a culinary haven, brimming with amenities and contemporary appliances, ready to inspire your culinary adventures.

Venture upstairs to discover two charming double bedrooms, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to ensure your comfort and convenience. From plush carpets underfoot to ample storage space and mirrors enhancing the sense of space, each element contributes to an unparalleled living experience. The beds are adorned with crisp hotel-quality linens, promising restful nights of slumber.

The bathroom, featuring a bathtub, awaits upstairs, offering a haven for relaxation after a day of exploration or indulging in a long soak.

Rest assured, the property will undergo thorough cleaning prior to your arrival, ensuring a pristine and welcoming environment for your stay.

listings.title: Apartment in London
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Greater London, United Kingdom
listings.description:
Fantastic location. walking distance to all major sights, close to Leicester Square, Piccadilly Circus and Tottenham Court Road.

Overlooks lively Frith Street, street noise in living area inevitable, noise from bar extractor fans in bedroom.

One bedroom, double sofabed, brand new kitchen, modern bathroom with shower. Attic flat, 64 steps, NO LIFT

IMPORTANT Please enter correct number of guests as price changes

The space
A little Soho Pride magic 🌈
Please note that 3 July 2027 falls during London Pride weekend, so Soho will be especially busy, lively and full of colour! Expect vibrant celebrations, crowds and a fantastic atmosphere right on your doorstep. It’s a wonderful time to experience Soho at its most joyful and inclusive.

APARTMENT DESCRIPTION

This attic apartment is nestled in the centre of Soho – the beating heart of London’s tourist and leisure district. This 4th floor apartment boasts sloping ceilings, hardwood floors, modern décor with feature walls, and original artwork. It’s full of character, including a charming (non-working) fireplace and stunning views of St Anne’s Church and the iconic clock tower, along with the picturesque rooftops of Soho.

The location is unbeatable, with iconic spots like Ronnie Scott’s Jazz Club, Bar Italia, and the Prince Edward Theatre just downstairs. Explore everything that makes a stay in Soho special!

There are 64 steps leading up top the apartment and NO LIFT/ELEVATOR so if you have mobility issues or large, heavy luggage please take that into account before booking.

The apartment is located in a very lively area so noise is inevitable both from the street and from the surrounding restaurants and bars including extractors but we think it's worth it to be in such an amazing location! If you are a light sleeper you may want to consider staying out of the centre.

This is the centre of London nightlife and the LGBTQ+ community, perfect if you want to join the fun, not so if you are looking for a quiet life. We do provide ear plugs for this reason.

All the furniture, fixtures, and fittings are brand new, including the kitchen units, appliances, crockery, and cooking essentials.

listings.title: Apartment in London
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Greater London, United Kingdom
listings.description:
Welcome to our stylish and comfortable 2-bedroom flat located in the prestigious SW3 area of Chelsea. This inviting home is perfect for both short and extended stays, offering you a quintessential London experience in one of the city's most sought-after neighbourhoods. Nestled in the heart of Chelsea, our newly refurbished two bedroom flat a Victorian-era building offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and classic charm.

The space
You’ll find yourself just moments away from some of London’s most iconic landmarks and attractions:

Battersea Park and the Battersea Power Station are just a short stroll away, perfect for a leisurely walk, morning jog, or an afternoon picnic.

For those who love shopping, you are within easy reach of the world-famous Harrods and Harvey Nichols, located in nearby Knightsbridge, offering everything from luxury fashion to gourmet food halls.

Culture enthusiasts will appreciate the close proximity to the Natural History Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, and the Science Museum, all just a quick bus or taxi ride away in South Kensington.

The Space:

This chic retreat features two bright and minimalist bedrooms. The master bedroom boasts a grand four-poster king-sized bed, while the secondary bedroom offers a plush king-sized bed, ensuring a restful night's sleep. The property is also equipped with two large free standing fans to maintain a cool environment.

The contemporary bathroom boasts large black and white tiles, complemented by black and gold accents. The luxurious feel is enhanced by white marble tiles and a glass shower enclosure including a rainfall showerhead and a matching handheld shower.

The open-plan kitchen and living area is a modern, inviting space that successfully blends comfort with style. The living room, adorned with modern artwork features a plush green sofa and a dark rust armchair, making it perfect for relaxation and socialising. You'll find a Smart TV with comprehensive Live TV/Video-on-demand options, including Sky Movies, News, Documentary, Comedy, Music, Kids channels, and full Sports Channels (Sky Sports/TNT/ESPN/Fox Sports, etc.).

The TV also offers many French, German, Spanish, Polish, and Asian channels, catering to international guests. To enhance your stay, the flat is equipped with a Sonos sound system, allowing you to enjoy high-quality music throughout the space.

The sleek white kitchen is equipped with modern appliances, including a Nespresso coffee machine, and features a breakfast bar where you can enjoy your morning coffee. A dining table with four chairs is set in front of a large, bright window, creating a perfect spot for meals.

Additionally, there is a quiet private patio with outdoor furniture for you to enjoy.

Guest access
This property offers self check-in

You will have access to the whole apartment/property and any communal areas
Linen, bed sheets, body lotion and shampoo will be provided.

listings.name: Machiavelli Guest House - Near Colosseum
listings.title: Bed and breakfast in Esquilino
listings.headline: Bed and breakfast in Rome, Italy
listings.description:
• 15 minutes walk from the Colosseum, with Metro A (subway) just around the corner and Termini Station (Rome’s main train hub) only one metro stop away.
• 4 modern rooms with private en-suite bathrooms, in a late-1800s building with high ceilings and large windows.
• Surrounded by authentic local restaurants, cafés and shops
• Wi-Fi, A/C, safe and mini fridge in every room 
• Shared dining area with snacks, coffee/tea station and microwave

The space
🏛 Machiavelli Guest House is a modern 4-room guest house located inside "Palazzo di Pietro Carnevale a Piazza Dante", a Roman building dating back to 1886 on the Esquilino, one of Rome’s Seven Hills. Nestled near the ancient first walls of Rome, our place offers a comfortable base for exploring the city.

🌟 The apartment has been carefully renovated to offer a modern, hotel-style stay while keeping the charm and proportions of the Eclectic architecture of the building: high ceilings and large windows fill the space with natural light, creating a relaxing haven amidst the vibrant history of Rome.

🛏 Each room has its own private en-suite bathroom and a simple and functional layout, with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, a safe and a mini fridge.

📍 The location is very convenient for exploring Rome. Metro A "Vittorio Emanuele" station is just 150 meters away (about 500 feet), with quick connections to the Spanish Steps, Piazza del Popolo, the Trevi Fountain and the Vatican area. 
Termini station (Rome’s main train hub) is just one Metro stop away, providing easy connections to Rome airports.
You'll be close to Colosseum (15 min walk) and the historic basilicas of San Giovanni and Santa Maria Maggiore (10 min walk). As you explore the area, you’ll find centuries-old churches, local streets and lesser-known corners that reveal Rome’s layered history.

🍝 The neighbourhood is rich with authentic Roman experiences, featuring traditional restaurants, historic norcinerie, renowned pastry shops, artisan bakeries and unique libraries, all within walking distance. 

☕ In the shared dining area, you will find a coffee and tea station, along with a selection of complimentary snacks and drinks, subject to availability.

Guest access
🔑 Guests access the apartment through smart locks with entry codes and have free use of shared areas. Each room is secured with a physical key for maximum privacy. Detailed check-in instructions are shared on the day of arrival, as soon as the room is ready, and always before the official check-in time of 3:00 PM.

🏨 The property is located on the second floor of a building equipped with an elevator. Please note: there are 8 steps to reach the elevator, which has a door width of 60 cm (about 24 in) and an interior size of approximately 130 × 70 cm (about 51 × 28 in). The property is not wheelchair accessible.

🕒 Check-in is available from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM, with late arrivals on request. Check-out is by 10:00 AM.

Other things to note
In Italy, all guests are required by law to provide valid ID details before check-in.
A few days before your arrival, we will contact you to complete your guest registration online. This information will then be submitted to the local police authority and other official government systems.

⚠ Please note:
- Daily room cleaning is included and is carried out between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. The cleaning team works on a scheduled daily round. If they cannot access the room during their cleaning round, they will not be able to return later the same day.
- The shared dining area can be used for snacks, drinks and takeaway food. A microwave is available for simple light meal preparation.

🛡 Safety features include a fire extinguisher, first aid kit, and an in-room safe.

Full Address is Via Machiavelli 25, 00185, Rome (RM), Italy

listings.name: Galò, your home at the Colosseum
listings.title: Condo in Monti
listings.headline: Entire condo in Rome, Italy
listings.description:
Enjoy your vacation in silence and in the heart of imperial Rome, a short walk from the Colosseum and the beauties of Rome. The apartment is spacious, bright and romantic, located on the fourth floor without elevator of a mid-nineteenth century building with rooftop views. It is finely restored, enhancing the original architectural elements of the time, the wooden beams and the brick walls. Ideal for 2 people, in addition to the double bed there is a comfortable sofa bed

The space
You will stay in the Monti district, one of the oldest and most characteristic neighborhoods in Rome. The Colosseum and the Imperial Forums are a short walk away. Piazza Venezia, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon and the other beauties of Rome can be reached in a few minutes' walk. The proximity to metro A and B allows easy movement within the city and to arrive comfortably by train or plane. It is surrounded by clubs, cafes, restaurants, and shops.

The apartment is a large, bright, quiet, elegant and romantic two-room apartment. It has a large living area with fully equipped kitchen, a relaxation area with sofa bed, a sleeping area with double bed, a bathroom with window and comfortable shower. Furnished with care and high quality, it is equipped with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, smart TV, washing machine, dishwasher, oven and every other comfort to spend a magnificent stay.

Guest access
The apartment is at the guests' complete disposal. It is professionally cleaned and equipped with linens according to the number of guests before their arrival.

It is located on the 4th floor without an elevator because it is in an old 19th-century building within walking distance of the Colosseum.

You can access the apartment using the codes placed both on the main door and on the apartment door, which will be communicated to you before your arrival. Inside the apartment, you'll also find the physical keys.

Check-in is from 2:00 p.m., and check-out is by 10:00 a.m.

Under Italian law, it is mandatory to register all guests and their period of stay on a dedicated State Police website. For this reason, you will be asked to send – via Airbnb messaging and by the check-in time – a photo of the government-issued ID (passport or identity card) of all the guests who are staying. 

Inside the apartment, you will also find a Welcome Book prepared for you with tips and useful information to make your stay even more enjoyable. In particular, you will find some suggestions on where to eat, drink, and what to try.

Other things to note
To ensure all our guests have a pleasant stay, please consider the following:

- Please respect the quiet of the place by avoiding noise at night. No parties allowed inside the apartment.
- Smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. 
- Before leaving the apartment for good, please turn off the lights, close the windows and leave the physical keys inside the apartment. If the keys are lost, a sum of €100 will be charged to replace the lock.
- There is no luggage storage after check-out. Luggage Storage is available within walking distance of the apartment (50 meters). 
- The house is furnished with quality materials, please take care of it.

listings.name: Charming Loft Studio near the Vatican, Roma
listings.title: Condo in Borgo
listings.headline: Entire condo in Rome, Italy
listings.description:
Charming, cozy and refined Loft Studio located in the historic Borgo Pio, one of the most beautiful and evocative neighborhoods in the center of Rome.
You are in the heart of Rome, within walking distance of St. Peter's Basilica.
The location is strategic for visiting the city on foot. In addition, the area is safe because it is adjacent to the Vatican.
You'll have an unforgettable time in Rome here!

The space
This sophisticated and cozy Loft Studio has been designed to maximize comfort: the sleeping area is raised on a wooden structure, offering a natural and intimate separation from the living area. 
The raised bed is not only a bed, but it is a design element that separates the rooms. 
Perfect for couples or young travelers looking for a functional and design solution.
Characteristic is the optimization of spaces, the "smart" design and the feeling of greater privacy compared to a classic studio apartment.

The apartment is cozy and comfortable (45 square meters), and is located on the second floor (no elevator) of a small three-story period building.
As it is an old building, it has wooden ceilings, exposed beams and wooden floors. So it's not completely soundproofed like modern buildings.
But its charm lies precisely in its antiquity!
It has been recently renovated and furnished with fine furniture.
The furniture is modern and functional.
The apartment is located on a small street adjacent to Borgo Pio, a splendid pedestrian area just a few minutes' walk from St. Peter's Square, the Vatican Museums and Castel Sant'Angelo, the true heart of Rome. 
The area is central, within walking distance of shopping streets, the "A" subway and bus stop.
It consists of a single room.
The comfortable and large double bed (170 x 200 cm) is raised and is located in a wooden structure specially built by a carpenter, which is accessed by a delightful and comfortable wooden staircase. 
The living room has a sofa and the dining area has an extendable glass table.
The fireplace is purely decorative, preserved not for its usefulness but for its history.
The small open kitchen has all the necessary amenities.
The kitchenette is fully equipped and has a refrigerator with a small freezer, microwave, Nespresso machine, American coffee maker, mocha, kettle, and toaster.
Also provided is a pantry with breakfast supplies: tea, coffee, Nespresso pods, sugar, cookies, and beverages such as coke and beer, kept cool in the refrigerator as my welcome. 
You will also find the necessities for cooking, such as olive oil, vinegar, salt and pepper, and spices.
You will also find at your disposal:
- additional toilet paper
- multi-surface cleaner
- dish soap
- soap for the washing machine
- dishwasher soap
- garbage bags
The bathroom is modern and has been completely renovated, with a large and comfortable shower, hairdryer, and toiletries.
The apartment has a modern 40-inch Smart TV and is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi Internet. 
Wi-Fi is fast, unlimited, and free of charge.
The heating is autonomous with a split, and the gas water heater produces hot water.
The apartment has air conditioning for cool air in the summer months and a small safe.
The washing machine is in a particular storage room under the television, where you will also find laundry soap. 
It is equipped with an iron and ironing board and clothes line for drying laundry. 
The bathroom is equipped with necessary accessories such as a hair dryer, hand soap, body wash, and shampoo. 
Bed linen and towels are provided.
The apartment is at the guests' complete disposal.
We inform our guests that the apartment will be cleaned and disinfected following a strict protocol.

Guest access
IMPORTANT INFORMATION:
THE BED IS RAISED.
IT IS NOT SUITABLE FOR CHILDREN OR ELDERLY PEOPLE.

CHECK- IN:
Arrival at the apartment must be after 3:00 p.m. and no later than 7:00 p.m.
Different times should be arranged when reserving. Arriving at the property without prior notice about the arrival time may result in a wait. Such misunderstandings are not grounds for complaints or claims for refunds.

EARLY CHECK-IN:
For guests arriving early in the morning, you may bring your luggage to the house from 10:00 a.m. onward and return later once the house has been cleaned.

LATE CHECK-IN
For guests arriving at the property after 7:00 p.m., specific arrangements must be made at the time of booking.

CHECK OUT:
The apartment must be vacated by absolutely no later than 10:00 a.m. on the day of departure.
LATE CHECKOUT IS NOT ALLOWED 
The house is always cleaned at 10:00 a.m. on the day of departure.
This schedule is fixed.

LUGGAGE STORAGE 
The house does not have a luggage storage room.
Automated luggage storage facilities can be found nearby.
Only in some cases will it be possible to leave your luggage locked inside the house at 10:00 a.m., returning to pick it up no later than 1:00 p.m.

Other things to note
▪︎ Exceeding the number of guests specified in the reservation is not prohibited.
▪Upon arrival at the house, guests are required to show their valid government-issued ID (passport or identity card) to our designated representative, which will be photographed so that they can be properly identified and registered via the required notifications to the competent authorities.
▪The fireplace is purely decorative, preserved not for its usefulness but for its history.

Beautiful and bright apartment overlooking St. Peter's in the heart of Rome, just a 10-minute walk from the Ottaviano metro station.

Located 200 meters from St. Peter's Basilica, Castel Sant'Angelo and the Vatican Museums, it is ideally located for visiting the city center.

The apartment is on the top floor with an elevator of an old building from the early twentieth century.

The space
It is very cozy and consists of a large bedroom overlooking St. Peter's and Castel Sant'Angelo, a living room with a double sofa bed, a bathroom and a full kitchen for a total of 50 m²

The bedroom has two windows overlooking St. Peter's and Castel Sant'Angelo and is equipped with air conditioning

The bright living room has a double sofa bed and is equipped with a television and air conditioning.

The bathroom is complete with shower and bidet 

The kitchen is fully equipped with a dishwasher, washing machine, coffee machine, microwave, kettle and induction hob with which you can cook

Other things to note
Free and unlimited wifi (fiber optic)

The heating is active from December to April as imposed by the municipality of Rome. 
As an alternative to these periods, if you want, in the bedroom and in the living room there are two air conditioners that also work as radiators.

listings.title: Apartment in Gracia
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Barcelona, Spain
listings.description:
Excellent, modern apartment with fantastic decked terrace. Balcony with views over Gracia’s unique main square. Surrounded by pedestrian streets, restaurants, cafés, terraces and two markets. Located close to metro and bus routes. Combine your stay with neighbourhood life. You’ll feel just like a local! Welcome!

The space
This light and sunny, wooden-floored apartment is on the third floor of a building without a lift. It was completely renovated in 2014, giving it a contemporary style while maintaining the original, typically Catalan, wooden beams.
The spacious, open-plan living room, with a comfortable sofa bed for a third and fourth guest, opens onto a balcony overlooking the main square of the Gracia neighbourhood. The flat also has a splendid, sunny, decked terrace, furnished with a table, chairs and a sunshade, for relaxing or eating outdoors.

Guest access
Free wi-fi internet connection, towels and bedding and fully equipped kitchen with a Nespresso coffee machine.
There is one double bed in the bedroom and a double sofa bed in the living room. A cot is also provided for a baby.

Other things to note
The apartment is located on the third floor and there is no elevator.

From Barcelona Airport, Terminal 1 or Terminal 2:
•Taxi: Available 24h. Approximately 35EU
•Aerobus bus service to Plaça de Catalunya: From 05:35h to 01:05h every 10 minutes. 5.90EU. Then Metro line 3 to Fontana station. 2.15EU
•Metro: From 05:00h to 24:00h. Line 9 Sud from the airport, changing to Line 3 to Fontana station. 4.50EU

The owner of the property reserves the right to ask the guest to leave the apartment in the case of inappropriate or irresponsible behaviour.
Please respect our neighbours. This apartment is in a private residential building and your neighbours work and need to get up early. Please do not make noise in the building or in the apartment and avoid playing loud music, particularly after 10pm.

listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Barcelona, Spain
listings.description:
Charming one-bedroom apartment in the heart of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, just a short walk from Las Ramblas and Plaça de Catalunya. Located in a 19th-century building, it features a small balcony perfect for relaxing outdoors. With capacity for 2 people, it offers a comfortable stay with a double bed, full bathroom, and equipped kitchen. Ideal for those seeking a central location and the authentic Barcelona experience.

The space
Located in the heart of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, this charming one-bedroom apartment invites you to experience the city’s vibrant atmosphere up close. Its location is truly privileged: just a 3-minute walk from Las Ramblas and only 5 minutes from the iconic Plaça de Catalunya.

The apartment is set in a 19th-century building that preserves the charm of historic architecture. It features a small balcony where you can enjoy your morning coffee or simply soak up the sun. Please note that the street is quite busy, so you may hear some city noise during the day.

Inside, the apartment has been designed to provide comfort and coziness throughout. The bedroom offers a comfortable double bed, quality linens, and plenty of natural light.

You’ll also find a fully equipped bathroom with fresh towels and toiletries, along with a kitchen that has everything you need to prepare meals, which can be enjoyed in the dining area.

Choosing this apartment means enjoying every essential comfort, together with the privacy and independence to explore Barcelona at your own pace.

Guest access
You will have exclusive access to the entire unit, ensuring privacy during your stay, and you will have Wi-Fi connection.

Access to the accommodation is available from 3:00 PM. If you wish to arrive earlier, you can check the availability of early check-in, subject to an additional charge.

If you have any questions about how to access the property, you can contact us at any time. We will be happy to help you so that everything is easy.

listings.title: Apartment in Gracia
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Barcelona, Spain
listings.description:
Cosy top floor apartment with terrace in the heart of alternative Barcelona

The space
Our kids call this flat The house on the tree - maybe because there is a garden with a big tree right below the terrace, maybe because the wooden roof beams suggest branches in the fall - so we start calling it that and we liked it and it stuck.

This is a beautiful top floor flat on the main pedestrian street in the Gracia quarter in Barcelona. 
In its large sitting room finds place a 4 seats crystal table, a comfortable Japanese sofa and an enormous TV set. The walled-in bookshelf offers books for all tastes and languages, from Dan Brown and his conspiracies to Fred Nieztsche and his dark moods, from spanish to swedish. The american kitchen is spacious and well equipped, the toilet is nicely tiled and sized. The bedroom is large and has a very soothing feel about it that tucks you graciously into a deep long sleep. 
The light comes in plentiful from both side of the flat and the days are best started out and finished off in the terrace, with warm croissant form the downstairs bakery in the morning, with icy drinks in the long summer nights.

The Woodfin is a chateau de bro, chalet de bae, camp for champs, and home for the roaming adventurer. Nestled in a quiet neighborhood just a 5 to 7-minute drive from downtown, this private dream pad is the perfect hub for couples, friends, and family to explore everything Asheville. Recharge in the high-end Tempurpedic TEMPUR-Cloud® bed for an unbeatable nights sleep! Fully equipped kitchen. Professionally cleaned!!

The space
DESIGN
Enjoy a minimalist aesthetic inspired by Scandinavian design with undertones of low-key surfer vibes. Crisp, white walls and large casement windows maximize light and warmth. Natural elements of wood, wool, and iron add intrigue and texture to the space. This homey abode invites you to relax and enjoy your company.

PARKING AND ENTRY
Complimentary off-street parking for two vehicles is located in front of the house. Guests enter using convenient keyless entry. Please do not block the driveway to the lower unit.

LIVING AREA
A large, open living area and accompanying kitchen with vaulted ceilings welcome you home from your adventures. The guitar is not just for looks. Go ahead and bless the house with your favorite Dave Matthews cover. Your suite has a smart TV with Netflix, Hulu, YouTube and other apps for your viewing pleasure. High speed WIFI is provided. The pop-up coffee table doubles as a laptop-friendly workspace and hidden storage for board games. 

KITCHEN
The kitchen is fully stocked with every utensil you’d need to make your own meals, so don’t hesitate to bring back fresh goods from the local farmer’s market. You can always save and reheat any leftovers from all the tasty Asheville eateries you are sure to visit. Guests may dine at the bar, which comfortably seats four. Coffee lovers will find the kitchen equipped with a Keurig coffee maker, complimentary K-cups, creamer, and sugar.

BATHROOM
Water pressure aplenty and endless hot water await you in the newly remodeled walk-in shower, perfect after a long day of earning your beers. Shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hand soap, toilet paper and a blow dryer are provided along with fluffy, white linens. 

BEDROOM
The spacious master bedroom features a high-end Tempurpedic TEMPUR-Cloud® bed and a separate seating area for two. The room is also spacious enough to accommodate a queen air mattress, located in the closet. Feel free to hang your clothes in the closet fitted with hangers. Extra towels, bedding, and an iron and ironing board can also be found in the closet. Four large casement windows may be opened to let in the breeze and a private, screened in porch can be accessed from the bedroom door. 

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
A good night’s sleep is vital for the weary traveler. Recharge on the incredibly comfortable TEMPUR-Cloud® Mattress with adjustable frame located in the bedroom. The living room sofa also pulls out to transform into a queen bed. A third option is the self-inflating, queen air mattress. Bedding is provided for the queen bed in the bedroom. Lofty, medium-warmth, down comforters and quality pillows paired with crisp and cool sheets are provided.

***Please specify planned sleeping arrangements for your guests. Bedding will be provided for sleeper sofa and/or airmattress only upon prior guest request. 

FRONT PORCH
The front of the house features a sizable covered porch overlooking the neighborhood charm and is a great place to relax outside or cook on the propane grill. A screened-in portion of the porch offers more privacy and can be accessed through the bedroom door.

DAMAGES POLICY
We work hard to keep our home in pristine condition. The reserving guest will be responsible for any breakage, missing items, damage to the building or furnishings (spills, burns, stains etc). We understand that accidents can happen, please report any breakage/damage/spills ASAP. We look forward to hosting you

PET POLICY
Pets are not allowed at this listing. Guests will be charged a fee of $250 if this rule is not followed. 

DISCLOSURE
The tankless hot water heater hums when turned on. Don’t be alarmed, it means endless hot water! 

The home is equipped with two security cameras that monitor the exterior entry points of the home.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire upstairs unit (ground floor) 877 sq. ft private suite, including the front porch, front yard, and front parking spaces. 

The lower unit is a studio apartment that I live in part time and also Airbnb. We ask that our guests please respect our request to remain on the upper floor and do not go beyond the wooden gate to the lower unit. The lower unit and back yard are for our personal use and/or for reserving guests. 

The units are separated by a well-insulated, professionally sound proofed ground floor and you should not expect to hear noise from guests not of your own party. Each unit has its own private entrance and parking.

Other things to note
Feel free to reach out! If I can make your stay any better, please let me know! Happy to accommodate :)

listings.name: All Things Bright & Beautiful Apt (Newly Built)
listings.title: Apartment in Asheville
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Asheville, North Carolina
listings.description:
A private entrance and space is a perfect place for your trip to Asheville. Enjoy fresh air on our private balcony. 
Our cleaning crew is taking extra steps to sanitize in between guests, above and beyond our normal high standards of cleaning.

Location: east side of W. Asheville, overlooking the River and River Arts District.
1.5 miles to downtown Asheville and downtown West Asheville.
3 minute walk to New Belgium
5 minute walk to the Greenway
Bike and run on the beautiful new Greenway.

The space
Our nearly 1,000 sq. ft. apartment has recently been completed and ready for your stay. With two large skylights and big windows the apartment is bright and cheery. Open the windows and enjoy the breeze coming up the hill off the river. 

***A remote workers dream with fast reliable WiFi. We opted for a drop leaf dining table that can transition into a work station.***

Enjoy your morning coffee on the balcony. One of our guests said "I feel like I'm in a tree-house when I'm on the balcony, I enjoy having my coffee out here every morning!"

The kitchen has lovely granite counter tops, a large sink, gas range and is well appointed and has everything you need to prepare meals. We will have coffee, tea and a few pantry breakfast items to get you started.
The master bedroom has a queen bed and a walk-in-closet.
The bathroom as a lovely tiled shower with seat.
There are two additional large storage closest for your extra belongings. 
Need a place for your bike? You may store it in the entryway or let us know if you would like to keep it in our garage.

Within walking distance to breweries and restaurants. Enjoy long walks or bike rides from the Greenway which is just a few minutes from the house.

*** The amazing River Arts district is just down the hill. Check out a studio stroll and enjoy the amazing artwork by local artists. We have access the Greenway, miles of walking and biking paths. You can go for a bike ride and end up at White Duck Taco for a bite to eat and a margarita. *** 

Please note that hurricane Helene has changed hours of local businesses. Please check to see if a business is open during your stay.

Guest access
You have a private entrance secure with a keypad entry. 
We have off-street parking for one car. If you have visitors during we kindly ask that they use street parking. There is plenty in front of New Belgium.

Other things to note
100% of your cleaning fee goes to our wonderful cleaning crew. They are a local family-owned business. 

The apartment is located on the 2nd story above a private garage. Please note that the balcony is very high, please be careful. Supervise children at all times and do not let them climb railings.

The apartment is comfortable for 4 adults.

EV Charging Policy:

Our EV charger is our personal charger and is located in our garage. We are happy to share it with guests, but please note that using it will require coordination on both our parts, as we will need to run it outside for access. If you prefer a more convenient option, there are public chargers available a block away at New Belgium.

Discover mountain seclusion with city convenience! This private, terrace-level suite features a separate entrance and designated parking. We live quietly upstairs if you need us, but the downstairs flat is completely yours. Enjoy a quiet retreat that puts the area's best right at your fingertips:

• 10 min to Downtown Asheville

The space

The downstairs terrace-level flat features:

2 Bedrooms & 1 Full Bathroom: Comfortably appointed for a restful stay.

Full Kitchen: Complete with a stove, dishwasher, and everything you need to cook at home.

Custom Climate Control: A ductless mini-split system allows you to set the perfect temperature in each individual room.

Living Area: Kick back and relax with an Amazon Fire Stick and complimentary Netflix.

Two Outdoor Spaces: Grill out on the covered terrace, or unwind under the stars around the gas fire table on the second river stone patio.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire separate downstairs apartment.

listings.description:
Welcome! Antiques + International + Funky AVL + Art + Comfort + Local tips = Your Spot to explore Asheville from historic Montford in a 120-year-old home. Private, sunny, 650 square-foot space. Relax and experience local living. Walking distance to downtown, the botanical garden and greenway. Filled with charm. Off-street parking and private deck. Enjoy a drink, meal or good book indoors or out. Relax, play, work or plan your next adventure. Celebrate something special. Rest well.

The space
This private space includes a private deck, sunny kitchen, living room, bedroom, bathroom and laundry. Hardwood floors, oriental rugs, antiques and art throughout the space add to the charm of the 120-year-old house as it combines the best of old and new. 

There are nine windows. Shades in every room ensure that all can be covered for privacy or open for natural light. Heating and air conditioning can be independently controlled in the kitchen, living room and bedroom to ensure your comfort. 

The kitchen includes a sink, refrigerator, range, microwave, toaster oven + kitchen ware. Dine or enjoy a drink indoors or out. The living room is spacious with a couch, comfy chair, antique secretary/desk, a spinning wheel from the late 1800s and a honky-tonk piano about that old. The bedroom with a Queen bed is made for comfort and restful sleep, has authentic French Provincial furniture. 

The bathroom has a walk-in shower. There is a squeegee hanging in the shower and a couple of swipes on the door before you open it will help the bathmat stay dry. Towels + shampoo, etc. are provided. There is a washer and dryer and a variety of detergents are provided. There's an antique dressing table in the bathroom, a magnifying mirror and several different types of lotion for your use. 

Enjoy the backyard and sounds of nature on the deck. You can walk to restaurants in Montford and enjoy our historic architecture or the greenway. If you want to plug in, wifi is on a 5G network. I connect globally for work on a regular basis and it is reliable. A portable speaker enables you to have music anywhere you like. 

Off street parking is available for small and mid-size vehicles. Larger trucks or SUV's can park easily on the street just behind the house and walk up the driveway. Please note that the drive is a gradual incline. When parked beside the deck it's about 30 paces to the gate and there are two steps to access. There are no additional steps in the space.

The apartment is an official, permitted Homestay with the city of Asheville having met all requirements including a site inspection.

About a 15-minute walk to downtown, and 1 minute away from from the greenway and new tennis/pickle ball and basketball courts. Great dining options for dinner or a wonderful breakfast or lunch are a 5-10 minute walk from the house.

Guest access
Midsize vehicles have easy off-street parking just steps away from the outdoor deck entrance. Please note that the drive is a slight incline. With only two steps up and you're in with nothing more to navigate. Large trucks or SUV's enjoy street parking with just a brief walk up the slight incline of the drive to the deck entrance. There is easy access to Lyft or Uber if you choose not to drive. The house is approximately 1.25 miles to the heart of downtown.

Other things to note
Asheville is known for its scenic beauty, abundance of opportunities to enjoy the outdoors, fantastic restaurants supplied with locally grown food, craft beer and eclectic sights and sounds. Great boutique shopping and local music and art offer plenty to do if you prefer to stay in town. We are also friendly in the best of the tradition of Southern hospitality.

Fall in Asheville is calling! Escape to our castle like retreat in historic Montford, just one scenic mile from downtown. Explore brilliant Blue Ridge fall color, the Parkway, Biltmore Estate, breweries, galleries, and local restaurants. Then come home, get cozy, and enjoy FREE NFL Sunday Ticket access or a courtyard campfire: we bring the wood, you bring s'mores! Neighborhood favorites like Nine Mile, Tall John's, and All Day Darling are a short walk or Lyft away. Maybe you'll see our bears!

The space
Access this one-bedroom apartment from the spectacular private courtyard, using the last 4-digits of your cell phone. A spacious living room is ready for you to relax and enjoy the bountiful sounds of nature just outside your backdoor. The dedicated bedroom has a king bed with pillows of all varieties, providing for your ultimate comfort. The kitchenette is equipped with a large sink, filtered water, microwave, refrigerator, Keurig, tea kettle, toaster, and utensils of all shapes and sizes. We look forward to hosting your stay in beautiful Asheville!

Guest access
Feel free to build a fire in the courtyard with the materials provided. Greg is happy to help start it for you- shoot us a text! Also, enjoy relaxing on the private back patio. Use the binoculars provided to watch for deer, birds, and BEARS!

Other things to note
Be sure to flip through the guidebook to find a list of some of our favorite restaurants! NOTE: many of our award-winning restaurants require a registration months in advance of visiting!
