listings.name: Asheville Daisy Cottage - Entire House
listings.title: Home in Asheville
listings.headline: Entire home in Asheville, North Carolina
listings.description:
Book Asheville Daisy Cottage! 

• Whimsy: Delightful daisy mural and flower artwork + cozy cushions throughout! 

• Outdoor Oasis: Sunny patio with a full dining table, loveseat, and an egg shaped swing chair!

• Fully-Equipped Kitchen: Stocked with appliances, utensils + essentials

• Location: 7-minute drive to Downtown AVL + River Arts District. 

• Remote Work-Friendly: High speed Wifi + dedicated desk with extra outlets and chargers

• Book Nerd's Delight: Stocked with books + games

The space
✨ Your Asheville Stay at Daisy Cottage: 

🌲 Sweet Dreams & Slow Mornings

Bedroom One: Snuggle into a plush mattress and enjoy a quiet dedicated workspace—perfect for a quick email before heading out to explore!

Bedroom Two: Drift off in total peace with blackout curtains and a calming forest view right from your pillow.

🍳 The Heart of the Cottage
Whip up breakfast in our newly renovated, fully equipped kitchen! We’ve stocked the spice rack and oil so you’re ready to cook. Enjoy the modern fridge, air fryer, stove, and microwave—plus a complimentary coffee and tea bar (cream and sugar included!) for those cozy mountain mornings.

🌿 Your Private Outdoor Oasis
Relax in the swinging egg chair, snuggle on the cozy loveseat, or share a meal at the al fresco dining set. As the sun sets, the solar twinkle lights create a magical glow for your evening glass of wine.

🚿 Refresh & Recharge
Our stylish new bathroom features a bright forest view, a spacious walk-in shower, and a huge vanity with plenty of room for all your travel essentials. Newly renovated and very clean!

🏠 Modern Comforts
Stay Connected: High-speed Wi-Fi and a Roku TV for movie nights.

My promise: The beds will always have 100% Cotton sheets. Always!

Total Comfort: Brand new HVAC system and an in-suite washer/dryer.

Easy Arrival: Plenty of free, private parking right on the property!

Guest access
This listing is for the entire home. 

🔑 Easy Check-In & Parking
Checking In Arrival is a breeze! Once you book, we’ll send over the secret code for our self-check-in lockbox. This ensures a private, contactless start to your getaway—though we’re always just a message away if you need a hand! 💌

Parking & Unloading 🚗 We have plenty of space for the whole crew (up to 6 cars!). To keep the cottage looking its best, please keep tires off the grass and stone walkway. 

Pro Tip: For the easiest arrival, we recommend unloading your luggage at the front gravel area first!

Parking Options: You are welcome to park in the front gravel area or down the driveway in the back.

Our Artist Studio: The detached garage out back is a creative artist studio! Please feel free to park there, just be sure to leave the garage doors clear.

**I have to say this again b/c folks keep missing this note: Please do NOT park on the grass or the stone walkway leading up to the house! Stay on the gravel please!!

Other things to note
🪵 A Note on Our Historic Charm
Daisy Cottage is a classic mountain beauty! Because we’ve preserved her original historic windows, they can be a little quirky to open and close.

 We have brand-new windows scheduled for late 2026, but until then, we appreciate you treating these vintage gems with a little extra love. 
🏔️✨

🌸 Locally & Woman-Owned
When you stay at Daisy Cottage, you’re supporting a locally owned, woman-run home—not a big corporation! My dream was to own my first house and you're making that possible! I pour my heart into making this space special for you, and I’m so glad you’re here!

listings.title: Apartment in Asheville
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Asheville, North Carolina
listings.description:
Live like a local in this spotless, comfortable home, complete with brand-new appliances and plush furnishings. Admire the tasteful artwork, daydream on the sun-drenched sofa and sink into the softest beds in this chic, classically decorated space.

The space
Experience Asheville like a local in this spotless and comfortable top-floor apartment, Downton Annie # Four. This chic, classically decorated space is designed for relaxation, featuring a sun-drenched living room, plush furnishings, and tasteful artwork that captures Asheville’s artsy-cool vibe.

Unwind on the vibrant sofa after a day of exploring, or prepare a meal in the modern kitchen, fully outfitted with brand-new, high-end appliances. The apartment includes two serene bedrooms with cushy Tempur-Pedic mattresses—one with a king bed and the other with a double—ensuring a restful
night's sleep.

Guest access
You will have private access to the entire apartment. The apartment is located on the top floor of a building with three other units. Access is through the building's main front door into a common interior stairwell that leads up to your apartment.

Other things to note
If you need additional parking for a second vehicle or for a larger sized vehicle , we can provide alternative spots upon arrival at no extra cost. 

This is a dog-friendly property, but not cat-friendly. Please do not leave your dog unattended outside or inside. Please remember to pick-up pet waste. Please do not use bath towels wipe wet paws. We ask that pet owners to bring their own dog towels, food bowls, and bedding. No pets on the furniture. If furniture has been stained or damaged by a dog, guests may be required to pay an additional cleaning fee. This is multi-tenanted building, with free parking.

Please note that, as often is the case when staying in a downtown neighborhood, you will inevitably have encounters with folks from all walks of life, including members of the unhoused population of our city. Among the neighbors on our street, is a service center that helps folks find housing and you will no doubt see some of their clients as you are walking down the street. We welcome you to read our reviews and notice that by and large, our guests feel safe and unbothered by this fact. Moreover, Downton Annie is a secure building with security cameras, locks, and the local police are never far if you feel unsafe but we want our guests to be able to have all of the facts at hand so they can choose in accordance with their level of comfort, as you will read in the reviews that it's not for everyone. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to ask before booking - we're here to set you up for a satisfying visit.

listings.name: Montford Bungalow
listings.title: Apartment in Asheville
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Asheville, North Carolina
listings.description:
You'll be staying in the heart of Montford's historic neighborhood with the lovely weirdness of downtown Asheville, less than a mile away. There, you will find the Drumming circle, great restaurants, many breweries, pottery studios, boutique shopping, glass blowing, street buskers and art galleries.

The space
About this space: A newly renovated private apartment with separate entrance. Located just across the street from one of Asheville’s favorite restaurants. Situated next door to the restaurant is Montford Convenience Store & Deli. Heading down the street you’ll pass several more yummy restaurants. In less than a mile you’ll be surrounded by art galleries, breweries, boutique shopping, street buskers, restaurants & Friday night’s drumming circle in funky downtown Asheville. We know you’ll love our city as much as we do!

This lovely 700 sq. ft studio apartment sleeps 5 people comfortably. Three in the main studio and another two in a completely, separate bedroom. The house was built in the 1920's & is furnished in that deco style. You will enjoy all the creature comforts; wifi internet and flat-screened enabled smart tv allowing streaming services such as Netflix, Hulu & Prime. A full refrigerator for your fresh groceries or restaurant left-overs. You can heat food in the microwave or toaster oven and you’ll find everything needed for a delicious cup of tea or coffee. Enjoy a rain shower in the spacious, tiled bathroom. Thick 100% cotton towels and sheets. Maps, games, books, & puzzles for your leisure. Umbrellas, masks & flashlights for evening walks.

We live upstairs; handy if you need us, but rarely seen, if you don’t. In a hundred-year old house, you may occasionally hear faint sounds of life above, but we’re extremely considerate of our guests.

Prior to your arrival the apartment will have been sanitized according to the Air BnB Covid Commitment.

Guest access
You may use the driveway on the right side of house (when facing) to unload your car, if you want. Apartment is located to the left at the end of driveway. This is a shared driveway so regular parking is on the street. There is always a place nearby. You will receive the code for the keypad prior to your stay.

Other things to note
We are located half-mile from the visitor center which is a great resource for guided tours, hop-on, hop-off tours, trail maps, and the local food scene.

listings.name: Historic 5 Points King & Queen • Walk DT • Parking
listings.title: Apartment in Asheville
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Asheville, North Carolina
listings.description:
Managed by Ania, the homeowner and longtime Superhost, this top-rated 2BR occupies the second floor of a historic Five Points duplex. Stylish, charming, and newly updated with high-quality carpeting in the living room and bedrooms, it offers an easy 10-minute walk to downtown, city views, and a prime spot in the grocery triangle (Harris Teeter, Trader Joe’s, Whole Foods). Steps to Five Points Restaurant and Little Jumbo on a lively corner, this location offers both convenience and local flavor.

The space
Experience Local Living in a Historic Five Points Retreat

Stay in the private upper-level unit of a beautifully updated historic home in Five Points. The upstairs unit has been newly updated with high-quality carpeting in the living room and bedrooms, adding warmth and comfort while also softening sound between floors. With no shared spaces, this cozy retreat offers 2 comfortable bedrooms (king and queen), 1 full bath, a convenient half bath, and a bright sunroom. Located just across Broadway Street from historic Montford and on a lively corner, you are within easy walking distance to breakfast spots, craft cocktails, coffee shops, groceries, and the Greenway. Downtown Asheville is just a 10-minute walk away, with Biltmore and the Blue Ridge Parkway only minutes by car. This is the perfect base for exploring Asheville’s best.

⸻

The Space
 • Wi-Fi: Fast and reliable, ideal for remote work, streaming, or staying connected.
 • Bedrooms: One king and one queen bedroom, both featuring high-end mattresses and luxurious bedding.
 • Bathrooms: One full bath plus a convenient half bath off the sunroom.
 • Living Areas: A bright sunroom with city views, an inviting living room designed for relaxation, and a cozy front porch.
 • Kitchen: Open to the sunroom and fully equipped with all essentials for cooking and dining in, with grocery stores just a block away.
 • Style: A mix of antique and mid-century decor adds charm and personality to the space.

⸻

Need More Space?

This is one of two separate apartments in a historic duplex. If you’re traveling with a group of 4–8, you can rent the entire home for extra space and privacy.

Full duplex listing:
https://www.airbnb.com/l/O0V4hLQI

Guest access
Guests enter the apartment through a private entrance on a small front stoop that leads directly inside. From the door, you’ll climb a full flight of interior stairs to reach the second-floor living space. This apartment occupies the entire upper level of a historic duplex, and all spaces are completely private—there are no shared areas with the downstairs unit. For security and smooth check-in, the front entrance is equipped with a Ring doorbell camera that monitors the exterior entry only.

Other things to note
This home is located in a lively Five Points spot close to downtown, so you may hear some traffic or general city sounds during the day. The neighborhood quiets down nicely at night, and most guests have shared that they don’t hear noise from inside. We provide sound machines in both bedrooms, along with earplugs and eye masks for our most sensitive sleepers.

The house is a historic duplex, and there is another apartment on the lower floor. The two units are completely separate, each with its own private entrance. We’ve recently added high-quality carpeting upstairs to create a warm, cozy feel and to soften natural sound between floors.

Please note that the apartment does not have a dishwasher or a washer/dryer. The kitchen is fully equipped for simple meals, and there are multiple laundromats and wash-and-fold services within a short drive for guest convenience.

Charming and bright private studio apartment in inner SE Portland, 4 blocks from "7-Corners". Walking distance to cafes, bakeries, shops, food carts, natural food markets, movie theater, restaurants and pubs.
Bike friendly
Washer/dryer
Secure storage
Private entrance
Kitchen with pantry basics/refrigerator 
Freezer/ice
WiFi
Sleeps 2 in standard queen bed
An air mattress is available upon request if more than two guests
Hydronic radiant floor heat

The space
Bright and cozy in perfect inner SE location for work or vacation.
Just 5 minutes from downtown.
Kitchen (gas range, refrigerator, toaster oven) and bathroom/shower.
Bath towels and bed linens.
Accent chairs for lounging.
Common area/workshop space is available for storage and gear, 
large capacity front-loading washer/dryer, & TV ( ROKU-Netflix/antenna HDTV).

Guest access
The private studio apartment is located at the back of the property, within a secure, fenced in, fully landscaped garden and courtyard behind the main house. Enter the back yard through cedar gate at the back of the driveway. ( The gate at the back of the driveway has a push-button-handle latch that is not locked; gently pull the handle while depressing the thumb button, the door swings inward.) The private entry to the studio has an electric push button lock; the code is provided just prior to arrival. Street parking is plentiful. Off street parking in the driveway is available with minor coordination with one other car.

Other things to note
In addition to pots, pans, cutlery, mixing and serving dishes, and temporary food storage, the pantry and kitchen are equipped with a basic complement of herbs and spices, sugar, oil, and vinegar, coffee (an adjustable bean grinder, auto-drip coffee maker, french press), and an assortment of green, black and herbal teas. An initial stock (a few days) of light fare of food stuff (e.g. oatmeal, eggs, bagels/bread, jam, butter) is provided in the pantry and fridge for a self service breakfast. Water supply is through a whole house hepa-filter.

Body wash, cotton cosmetic pads, lotion, shampoo, conditioner, towels, Q-tips, hair dryer, and scale are provided in the shower/bathroom. 

An iron and ironing board are in the closet, along with some office supplies, playing cards.

There is a bookshelf loaded with some good reads and information on local amenities. 

There is an alarm clock AM/FM radio on the night stand.

The courtyard and garden in the back are available for relaxation and fresh air. During dry/summer months, patio furniture and BBQ are set up for general use. 

The shop on the first level (also accessible from the stairwell) has a 7 cubic foot front loading washer and dryer; detergent/softener/bleach provided. The shop can also be used for storage of luggage, gear, bikes etc., w/man cave amenities: dart board, full stereo, a few basic chairs, and TV w/ROKU/Netflix/local antenna HDTV, if you need that sort of fix.

420 OK outside, balcony or shop.

listings.name: Charming, bright + cozy gateway to PNW adventures!
listings.title: Guest suite in Portland
listings.headline: Entire guest suite in Portland, Oregon
listings.description:
We are a cozy, renovated 1950's home featuring a private 1 bed/1 bath guest suite. Nestled in the Montavilla neighborhood, we are close to local coffee shops, restaurants, and more. Our home is packed with both practical and unique amenities for a perfect stay, including ample street parking. Whether visiting for a weekend trip or booking an extended stay, we are the perfect choice for your needs! Please note: home next door under construction and there is another Airbnb next door (shared wall).

The space
Welcome to your home away from home in the heart of Portland! Our renovated 1950s guest suite is designed with warmth, comfort, and convenience in mind—whether you’re here for a weekend adventure or an extended stay. Nestled in the vibrant Montavilla neighborhood, you’re just steps away from charming coffee shops, mouthwatering restaurants, buzzing bars, and local gems. Plus, with ample street parking, getting around is a breeze.

☕ Relax, Recharge & Feel at Home

Step inside and kick off your shoes—you won’t be needing them as you settle into this cozy retreat. The private 1-bed/1-bath suite is perfect for up to 4 guests and comes with a fenced backyard where you can sip your morning coffee or unwind under twinkling string lights. The garden, filled with ferns and native plants, creates a peaceful, green escape that feels like your own private oasis. For added comfort we have an air purifier, and we offer an AC unit from June through September.

🛏️ Sleep Like Royalty

Your private sanctuary features a plush queen-sized bed, wrapped in luxury linens with firm and soft pillows to suit your preference. Need some extra shut-eye? We’ve got blackout curtains and a white noise machine to ensure peaceful slumber. Traveling for work? A dedicated desk with high-speed 5G Wi-Fi has you covered.

For groups of 3+ guests, the queen-sized sleeper sofa, which includes a 3” foam mattress pad and mattress topper for extra comfort, provides a cozy night’s rest. Just let us know if you’d like it set up before your arrival!

🚿 A Spa-Like Bathroom Experience

After a day of exploring, treat yourself to a steaming hot shower in our newly renovated spa-inspired bathroom. Enjoy:
✔ Powerful water pressure
✔ Handheld showerhead
✔ Luxury bath towels & robes
✔ Complimentary shampoo, conditioner & body wash

🍽️ Cook, Grill, or Dine Out

Whether you’re a takeout connoisseur or a home chef, we’ve got you covered! Our fully stocked kitchen includes:
✔ Fresh local coffee beans, K-Cups, & syrups
✔ Oils, spices, and pantry staples
✔ Full-size fridge, electric range & all cookware
✔ Propane BBQ grill for sunny-day cookouts

Prefer to eat out? You’re in walking distance to some of Portland’s best cafés, food trucks, and restaurants.

🎬 Entertainment for Everyone

Rain or shine, there’s plenty to do indoors! Cozy up on the couch and enjoy:
✔ Two Smart TVs with Netflix, Hulu & Disney+
✔ Board games
✔ Books
✔ Record player and records

🌲 The Perfect PNW Basecamp

We’re in a prime location for all things Portland and beyond!
🚗 3 min – Fred Meyer grocery store
🚗 10 min – Moda Center (Blazers games & concerts)
🚗 13 min – Downtown Portland
🚗 15 min – PDX Airport
🚗 18 min – Oaks Amusement Park
🚗 30 min – Multnomah Falls
🚗 60 min – Evergreen Aviation & Space Museum
🚗 75 min – Willamette Valley Wine Country
🚗 90 min – Mt. Hood & Oregon Coast
🚗 105 min – University of Oregon (Go Ducks!)

✨ Book Your Stay Today!

We’re excited to host you and ensure your Portland experience is one to remember. Have a special request? Just let us know—we love making our guests feel at home!

Your cozy PNW adventure starts here!

Please note that the neighboring property is currently under construction, which may result in occasional noise and visible work, and has impacted our garden area, which is being redone and may not appear exactly as pictured.

Guest access
Guests will access the home through the front entrance via Smart Lock. A six digit code will be shared with the guest 48 hours prior to check-in; the code will become active at 3:00 pm on the day of check-in and deactivate at 11:00 am on the day of checkout. This allows our guest to have a self-guided check-in at any point after 3:00 pm on the day of their arrival.

The hosts will be available remotely for any needs during check-in.

Other things to note
Owner may walk through the backyard for rain gutter cleaning. The front yard will have the landscaping renovated from September 22 through October 9. This will not disrupt guests entry.

If you value natural light, sincere hospitality, strong AC, and being able to do laundry on vacation, this is for you! Our brand-new, airy 500 sqft cottage guesthouse is the perfect home base for your visit to Portland. Come and discover why we’ve consistently been rated as top 1% ✨ 

Location can't be beat: Nestled in the vibrant heart of SE, this private retreat is walkable to incredible dining, small businesses, and the natural beauty of Mt. Tabor Park. All are welcome here!

The space
A Private Retreat: The studio has its own entrance and keypad lock for an easy and secure self check-in.

Stylish Comfort: Relax on the large leather sectional, perfect for curling up with a good book or enjoying movie night. The studio also boasts a breakfast table, ideal for dining or remote work. The efficient HVAC system keeps you cool in summer and cozy in winter. No harsh overhead lighting here: put it in “night mode” for a golden glow. 

Fresh Kitchenette: Our modern kitchenette comes equipped with a coffee maker, freshly-ground locally roasted Stumptown coffee, Smith Tea, an induction cooktop, countertop convection oven, built-in fridge, and dishwasher.

Sweet Dreams: In the cozy sleeping nook, you'll drift off to sleep in a queen-sized bed with bedside chargers and reading lights. The super comfortable hybrid Casper mattress is ideal for any kind of sleeper, and we provide 100% cotton sheets and a fresh linen duvet for your ultimate relaxation.

Smart Storage: The built-in wardrobe with floor-to-ceiling mirrored doors offers ample hanging and drawer space for all your belongings.

Convenience: An in-unit washer/dryer, detergent, and ironing board are included, making laundry a breeze.

Elegant Bathroom: Pamper yourself in a well-appointed bathroom with high ceilings, an additional skylight, and a walk-in shower adorned with beautiful zellige tiles.

Charming Patio Space: Enjoy your morning coffee or evening glass of wine on the sweet patio, featuring a cafe table and chairs, and decking.

Host Cats! You might be greeted by one of our friendly kitties. Not a fan of cats? Don't worry, they can take a hint.

Located just around the corner from Good Coffee and Petite Provence, and a few blocks from the original Stumptown Coffee flagship. Explore nearby food cart pods, savor delicious bites at the many nearby restaurants! Need to stretch it out? Enjoy a full roster of yoga classes at the Breathe Building around the corner. 

Experience the perfect blend of comfort and local flavor in our sweet studio. We look forward to hosting you!

Guest access

Other things to note
Like any popular neighborhood, street parking can be limited from time to time. 

We’ve never had to park more than a block away at most, but it might not be ideal for those with limited mobility or anxious parallel parkers. 

Street parking is free and does not require a permit.

listings.name: Cozy, yet Spacious Division 1BR Apt
listings.title: Apartment in Portland
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Portland, Oregon
listings.description:
Great landing spot for parents visiting adult children (+ grandkids), businesspeople & tourists. Clean. Bright. Well-stocked!

Note: Airbnb has changed how they display host prices to include AirBnB's service fee that used to be paid directly by guests: 14.1-16.5%. Thus, our nightly rate looks higher because you now pay your AirBnB fee thru the host (me). 

Nothing has actually changed in terms of my prices and I am committed to maintaining moderate pricing levels.

The space
The basement of this 1913 home was refinished as a surprisingly spacious yet homey and bright one-bedroom, non-smoking apartment with separate entry. 

Walk 5 minutes to popular Division St. restaurants & buses downtown or stroll 15 minutes to Hawthorne St. through actual Portlandia neighborhoods.

Includes a fully-ready kitchen, a breakfast bar and a dining table. Three south-facing windows provide nice natural light and look to a colorful garden in spring, summer and fall. Fast Wi-Fi. 
 
Many guests have noted: "Great shower water pressure!" The bathroom includes a slightly raised toilet - good for seniors. The well-insulated space warms quickly, as needed, with wall-installed Cadet heaters.

Neighbors out & about by day; quiet at night.

Guest access
Everything you need: full kitchen, comfy living space with two couches and two reclining chairs, separate bedroom, Roku for streaming and fast wi-fi that makes the internet fly. The bedroom in the back corner of the apartment feels far away from your partner in the kitchen when space is needed. Private entrance and access to shared washer/dryer. Street parking available.

Other things to note
If you are interested in staying for more than 21 days (though 30 is the max), please make a special request through AirBnB.

listings.name: Parkside Urban Oasis
listings.title: Guest suite in Portland
listings.headline: Entire guest suite in Portland, Oregon
listings.description:
A perfect location to explore the city! Easy access to public transportation and close to the vibrant Clinton / Division / Hawthorne / Belmont / Montavilla neighborhoods for the best dining, coffee, bars, parks and more!

1 block from magnificent Mt Tabor Park, the only extinct volcano within city limits in the US. Enjoy acres of trails and a quiet, restful environment.
 
Please do not book until you have read/agreed to entire listing before booking for hot tub/guest/pet/rules.

The space
Hi! 

The outdoor space is shared with our family so we have some specific restrictions on guests, outdoor use, etc. We keep the price below market to offset these, so please don't book just because it is less expensive. 

🙏🏼Fully read through the entire property description/rules! especially the "Other details to note" section in the listing prior to booking. You are accepting all house and property rules by booking and any policy exceptions for visitors, etc. MUST be requested PRIOR to booking. 

Our guest suite is situated on the lower level of our innovatively designed, eco friendly modern home. The open floor plan makes good use of abundant natural light and the space looks out to a covered patio that overlooks our spacious backyard. Truly an oasis in the city! 

The clean, modern lines of the space are highlighted with high-end, super custom finishes and lots of furniture we designed and built ourselves to fit the unique space. 

There is an on-demand hot water heater and radiant heating/cooling system. A note about the cooling though, if you run hot and like the feel of cold air on your face, you will not be happy with cooling. The system does a good job of keeping the space between 70-80 degrees (the upper end when temps are close to 90) but if you need a boost (only available when the temperatures will be above 90 for more than 2 days in a row), we can offer you a portable ac unit (will sit on the floor or side table and goes out through the window), but please let us know this when you book so we can make sure to have it ready and set up even if we are out of town.

The kitchen is fully stocked with cookware, dishware and organic pantry staples (flour, sugar, spices, etc.) and we like to make sure you have whatever you need for a nice cup of coffee or tea each morning, so we'll check in to check in on any dietary restrictions prior to your arrival. 

There is a combo blender/food processor, hand mixer/immersion blender, coffee maker and a second faucet that supplies both filtered water and instant hot water. We have a high end, automatic espresso maker in the space that is stocked with a rotating selection of one of the delicious, local medium roast coffee that Portland is famous for. To approximate a regular brewed cup of coffee, just add some hot water from the instant tap. We also have a milk frother there for you to make a perfect latte.

There are a few glass growler jugs for your use during your stay (if that is not a thing where your are from, here many of the brewpubs, grocery stores and convenience stores have beer on tap that you can fill a growler of your own with - delicious and ecofriendly!)

We are avid home cooks so take our kitchen stocking seriously - there is an assortment of good quality pots and pans in different sizes (including a large soup pot and roasting pan and rack), a couple of titanium non-stick pans, baking sheets and an assortment of baking dishes. There is also a kitchen scale and meat thermometer. If there is anything else you need that you'd like to borrow from us, just let me know - we are so happy share. 

In the bedroom, there is a high-end memory foam mattress and room for a pack and play at the end of the bed. We can also set up a cot at the edge of the living area for you and/or a separate sitting or standing desk if you prefer an work area separate from the dining table, but do need at least a week's notice to get it out of storage, cleaned and set up for you. For stays less than 4 days, there is an addition cost of $50 for each items.

Guest access
Please be sure to fully read the "other details to note" section in the listing before booking as you are agreeing to all of those terms and conditions when you book 

The guest suite is accessed by entering through the gate that is on the right (west) side of the driveway. You will walk the entire length of the path to the back of the house to the unit entry at the patio under the covered deck above.

You will have sole and private access to the entire guest suite, which is completely private from our main residence above. We sound proofed as much as possible, but we do have concrete floors above, so there is some mild noise that might filter through the ceiling of the living and kitchen areas of the unit. Comparable to what you might hear in hotel room. 

The covered patio outside the space will be for your sole use as well during your stay and has a couple lounging chairs, a small bistro table for 2 and a full sized propane grill. The hot tub is adjacent to this space and will also be for your sole use during your stay. We occassionally have to jump in to fully clean and maintain it, so for longer stays, you may see one of us pop in for a few minutes to do that. We'll send you a message with some notice if we do. 

 You are welcome to share the rest of the yard as well as the space in the extra lot behind the hous (the backyard is open to it and it is accessed by a few steps down. It is important for you to read and understand the rules for use in the "Other details to note" section.

Other things to note
Quiet hours are in the outside spaces between 8pm-7am and there is no use of the hot tub or rest of the yard during that time. We have wonderful neighbors and prioritize respect for their peace and quiet. The open dates on our calendar often coincide with days that we will gone most of the days (our kids play a lot of sports and we are an active, outdoor family) or are out of town, so you will enjoy the same peace and quiet. 

The hot tub and main upper yard spaces are for the sole use of our registered guests (we will not share these with you during your stay except to travel from our deck stairs down to the lower extra lot/sport court) and may only be used quietly and respectfully between the hours of 7am-8pm. 

Despite the hearty foot traffic to the park, the neighborhood gets almost strangely quiet in the evenings and early morning. The hot tub and outdoor space is directly below ours/our neighbors master bedroom windows and even the sound of normal, casual conversation carries quite loudly through the corridor between the houses during quiet times. Having said that, we do really want you to enjoy the space, so if you want to sit outside (even in the hot tub) during quiet hours and read a book, listen to music with earbuds or headphones, take a nap, etc. go for it. But no conversations or noise above a whisper please during quiet hours. 

Inside: as long as it's not loud enough to carry outside, we don't really care - noise from the unit does not tend to travel upwards to us, so don't worry about the volume of yourself, your tv or music. 

We do not allow parties and gatherings. We will sometimes grant very limited exceptions for small gatherings, no more than 6 total at any time, for holidays or special occasions so feel free to ask ahead of time, but please do not assume it is ok. 

No persons other than the guests registered on your reservation are allowed on the property without prior permission, especially to use the hot tub or the sport court. The sound of a bouncing ball can be really annoying to neighbors so we try to limit our own use of the court to an hour max a day and will ask the same of our guests. 

Permission for visitors needs to be requested and approved prior to booking. We are usually pretty flexible in allowed a visitor or 2 to the inside space, but rarely for use of the hot tub or sport court. For reference, an example of an exception we sometimes consider would be a grandparent or aunt babysitting a grandchild or nephew (we have a lot of guests coming to visit family and help during medical or personal transitions). We ask that you do not share the gate or door codes with non-registered guests and that you are responsible for making sure they know to keep the entry gate closed at all time and to not let our dog out if she is out in the yard. 

Our no smoking/vaping policy is very strict and encompasses the entire premises including all outdoor areas and smoking of all things, even marijuana (even though it is legal). You will be asked to leave immediately with no refund if you violate this policy and we will charge a minimum $300 fine+cost of mitigation if we find either during or after your stay that this has been violated. If you are a smoker and choose to travel to smoke off the property, please know that smoke smells will linger in your clothing and hair and will likely be transfered to the furniture and the inside of our space. In this case, you will be responsible for any extra time (billed at $100/hr) to air out the space, shampoo/clean the sofa, rugs and to reclean clean towels/bedding that may absorb the smell. In a nutshell, we prefer non- smoking guest. 

SPORT COURT USE: We are happy to share the basketball/pickleball court with you during your stay. Please do shoot us a message if you are planning to use that space, so we can coordinate timing. We are super flexible/accomodating, but do occasionally have our own plans to play or have some private coaching sessions for our kids. 

 If you would like to borrow a ball/raquets, please let us know asap so we can get them out of the locked shed for you before we leave the house. Please take good care of the borrowed items and do not leave them out on the court when not in use. Please take them back into your space. If a ball flies off the property (we do have netting in place in help avoid this!), just let it go and let us know where to look and we'll retreive it from the neighbors!

PETS: We allow 1 well- behaved dog who is trained to behave as requested below, with an additional pet fee of $50. We cannot accepts cats or other pets who will be on the furniture due to our household's allergies. Please be sure to indicate when you make your reservation that you are bringing a pet with you so the fee will be assessed through your booking. You will be sharing our outdoor space with our very friendly and submissive medium sized dog (35lbs) and kids, so if your dog has any aggression or nervousness towards other animals or people, we unfortunately cannot accomodate you, even if they are leashed at all times. This included barking or threatening behaviour to strangers (i.e. us). Please let us know if you are traveling with a service animal. They are still required to meet our behaviour expectations but we are happy to refund the pet fee with the proper documentation. 

Dogs are not permitted on the furniture or beds and guest agrees to pay an additional cleaning fee for the sofa and the space and/or repair fees associated with failure to comply that will be around $300 or more. If your pet is not able to be in the space quietly and comfortably when you are away (i.e. no excessive barking or jumping up on the furniture) you will need to take them with you at all times, or we unfortunately cannot accommodate you. Many dogs will bark incessantly when left alone in a new space and if this occurs, you are agreeing at the time of booking that you will immediately check out of the space and not be entitled to any refund of your stay. 

Only fully potty trained dogs that are at least 2 years old and with whom you have previously traveled with are allowed. You need to be sure that your furry friend is safe and comfortable in spaces outside your home. No puppies or senior dogs with bladder control issues please: Even though the concrete floors are sealed, pet urine is acidic and will soak through and leave stains/smell that are very hard, if not impossible, to remove. 

*Generally* pets are not allowed off leash on the property are never allowed to be unattended or unsupervised on the property. Dogs are not permitted to walk in or pee/poop in the raised beds or the landscape plants on the lot below or the herb beds at the back edge of the upper yard. They must be kept off the sport court at all times. The charge to restore the turf will begin at (and may exceed) $250 per area if your dog digs and $700 per bed to remove soil and restore any raised garden beds that your dog contaminates with pee/poop. Please know that these rules apply to our dog as well. It goes without saying that all pet waste must be promptly picked up and discarded. 

 If you feel comfortable that under your direct supervision (i.e. you are physically close enough to immediately stop any unwanted behaviour) that your pet will abide by the above, please feel free to enjoy the space together off leash. We will need to make sure that your dog will not be aggressive towards ours first (she is quite submissive which can bring out a mean streak in aggressive dogs). There is a also a lovely, large off leash area in the park that is about 3/4 mile of a walk from our place. Let us know if you want directions to get there, but there is also a map of the park in the space for your convenience. 

All poop must be promptly and immediately picked up and deposited in the small, gray trashcan under the stairway outside. There will be a minimum charge of $75 to pick up any pet waste and know that our dog almost exclusively poops on her morning and evening walks in the neighborhood and not in the yard. We want to maintain these spaces to be enjoyed by you and our family for soccer, laying in the grass/hammock, etc. without fear of stepping in it!

No visiting pets are allowed onto the property at any time for any reason, even if they belong to approved visitors. 

There will be a $50 charge from the cleaners if they arrive and you are still in the space The charge will then be $50/every 30 minutes until you depart. They service many air b and bs in the area and are usually on a really tight schedule, sorry! But, also please don't hesitate to ask if you'd like an earlier check-in or a later checkout and we are happy to find out if the cleaners can accommodate...

We will need to know at least a week ahead of time if you will need any additional items for your stay (extra twin bed set up, pack and play, toddler cot, baby bathtub, high chair, extra standing/sitting desk) so we can have them clean and pulled out of storage for you . The walk in shower is large and easily fits an adult and a baby tub, and there is also a separate hand shower that works great to fill up the tub or to clean toddlers who aren't quite big enough for a regular shower. 

We traveled a lot with our kids when they were very young and enjoyed many of these small kindnesses in our travels so it brings us joy to provide these items at no extra charge, but please do make sure to leave all the items clean as the cleaners will charge an extra fee (that will passed along to you) for cleaning dirty items. 

There is a $50 charge each for set up/breakdown of the extra twin bed or desk. This is waived for stays of 6 nights or more or if you have a registered 3rd guest. 

Phewww, you got through the entire essay! Thanks so much for taking the care to understand our space before booking. If the space is right for you, our family looks forward to welcoming you to our space!

Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

The bathroom has lovely heated floors, there is a full kitchen with all new appliances, new floors, and is located in the heart of Slabtown. Walk easily to the Pearl District, or the shops of Slabtown, NW 21st, or NW 23rd! 

Everything in the unit is brand new, and built specifically for vacation rental. The living room has extra space with a queen sleeper sofa, and a day bed and a twin sleeper chair.

The space
In my home you will find one bedroom, one bathroom with great water pressure, dual shower head with wand, heated lighted mirror, and heated tile floor, a full kitchen with dining space, and living room with ample seating (and convertible sleeping space for three) and a 55" 4K HDTV. The unit also has a in unit washer and dryer for laundry.

Easy entry via the front door with an electronic lock system to provide 24/7 access. The walkways are illuminated after dark to this no step entry unit.

The fully-equipped kitchen contains a full size oven, 4 burner cooktop, dishwasher, microwave, toaster, fridge and freezer, coffee making equipment (including, cuisinart drip coffee maker, Aeropress coffee maker, Chemex coffee maker, Burr coffee grinder & digital kettle -bring your favorite beans), cooking supplies (including pots & pans, cooking utensils, baking sheet & knife block).

Charging stations throughout the house make it easy to keep your devices powered! Kitchen: In wall charging stations, Living room: charging console tables, bedrooms: charging tables & lamps, even the bathroom has one in wall USB charging station.

The neighborhood predates common use of cars and so there is no driveway. The entire area is paid street parking unless you have a permit. We provide ONE digital parking permit for the duration of your stay at no additional cost.

To ensure the safety of all guests on the property we do not accept third party bookings. The booking guest must be present at check in and intend to remain for the duration of the reservation.

Guest access
You have full access to the interior of your unit. The upper unit is a separate rental. There is no internal or external connection between the spaces. Your unit is private.

Other things to note
We strive to provide a comfortable space for all and so please note this is a non-smoking/vaping property inside and out. 

We have several other listings that are visible in our profile and so if you have a need for more spaces or combining bookings please consider reaching out to see if we may be able to accommodate your request.

The Nest is situated on the second and third floors of this charming Old Portland home. The house is central to everything Eastside, boasting a walk score of 94! Belmont & Hawthorne have incredible eateries, bars and shopping only a few steps away. It is also very close to the heart of the Division, Stark, SE 28th & Burnside commercial districts. It's a 5 minute walk to Laurelhurst Park, voted the most beautiful park on the west coast, & only 2 miles from downtown, The Pearl and Mt. Tabor Park.

The space
On the second floor (the main floor of the flat), you will find a large bedroom with a king bed and RokuHDTV, a newly remodeled bathroom, a living room with RokuHDTV, workspace, and a comfortable pullout couch. The third floor is a unique attic space with an additional queen bed and additional seating area. There is also a kitchenette/dining room with a sink, fridge, microwave, electric kettle, coffee maker and toaster. It is stocked with all the dishes and flatware, etc...you will need. The house has A/C. The Nest is a duplex, and you have your own private secure entry at the top of the stairs.

Guest access
When you enter the front door, you will continue up the stairs to the coded door-lock at the top. Note the thermostat on the way up the stairwell, that is how you can adjust the temperature on the main floor of The Nest. The second bedroom, in the attic, has its own controllable heat source.

Other things to note
Prohibition is over. We have noticed that many people visiting Portland are curious and/or excited about cannabis. The Nest is cannabis friendly. Feel free to smoke or ingest cannabis in the Nest. We also provide a card to redeem at Farma, Portland's most awarded dispensary, for a $2 preroll and 10% off of your other purchases. So enjoy! Please note that there is a strict no tobacco use in The Nest. You may smoke tobacco on the front porch. Also know that the owner smokes Cannabis downstairs and you may notice it.

✨ Sunlit Suite Steps from NW 23rd Shopping & Dining ✨

🌳 Timeless charm meets modern comfort in Portland's best neighborhood
🛏️ Cozy queen bed + plush sofa for two
🍳 Full kitchen with stove, oven & microwave
🛋️ Smart TV, fast WiFi & dedicated workspace
🐾 Pet-friendly — bring your furry friend
❄️ AC & heating for year-round comfort
🔒 Private entrance — entirely yours
🍽️ Steps from boutique shops, top restaurants & tree-lined streets.

The space
• Located in a classic early-20th century 8-plex in Portland’s Alphabet District
 • Beautiful natural light with large windows throughout
 • Comfortable living area with Smart TV and mid-century inspired furnishings
 • Fully equipped kitchen with gas range, microwave, and full-size refrigerator
 • Queen-size bed with high-quality linens and calming, minimalist decor
 • Elegant vintage details—wood floors, curved archways, built-in shelving
 • Split AC/heating system keeps the space comfortable year-round
 • Fast WiFi for streaming, remote work, or planning your Portland adventures

Guest access
Guests have full, private access to the entire apartment. This is a standalone unit within an 8-unit building. Stairs are required to access the listing.

Other things to note
We want your stay to be as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. Please note the following:

Charming, comfortable, well-appointed studio, in an historic building, authentic, fully restored with modern conveniences, just steps away from everything downtown Portland has to offer: restaurants, museums, shopping, galleries, parks, Congress Street, and the Old Port. Close to Maine Medical and Mercy Hospital, the Portland Expo, Sea Dogs stadium, and Deering Oaks Park. The studio rental includes free parking for one car and exclusive use of a hot tub.

The space
Large, open studio with beautiful furniture and a queen size bed, including a full kitchen with gas stove and dishwasher, full-size refrigerator, along with a small living room area. There's also a washer/dryer. We are on premises and make sure that the rental is clean, welcoming, and well-maintained. Please note that the artwork in the pictures rotates, so the walls may be decorated with something different than this listing shows. You should also know that this is a busy, urban location, so expect typical street noise, as well as possible noise from neighbors. We provide a white noise machine that most guests find effective in keeping things quiet, though with the age of the building, noise from above can be noticeable.

Guest access
There is a hot tub for your exclusive use, located just outside the front door. A pull-out screen adds privacy across the entranceway while you’re using the spa. Only you can access the walkway and the hot tub. The spa is big enough for two or three adults. This is an urban environment, with other buildings around us and the patio where the hot tub is. Please see the “other details” section below for notes on privacy.

Other things to note
Please note that the hot tub is for your exclusive use and that there is a retracting privacy screen that stretches across the walkway to block views of the tub. The hot tub is on the patio adjacent to two neighboring buildings, so people using the tub could be viewed from above. There is also a doorbell camera, activated only by very close motion or pressing the doorbell button. It cannot be activated by motion in the hot tub. Guests will find a roll of tape in the bedside table drawer which they can use to cover the doorbell camera during tub usage if they’d like (please uncover the doorbell when done with the hot tub as it is an important security feature.)

Bright and cozy apartment in Portland's Munjoy Hill neighborhood with private backyard deck. Short walk (like a minute!) to neighborhood bagels, coffee, breweries, beach, playgrounds, restaurants and 15 minute walk to the Old Port & Downtown. 

Ample/free street parking available. Our family of four lives upstairs, our home is surrounded by flower gardens and located on the Portland Trail system. We welcome all folks of all backgrounds to our home and neighborhood!

The space
The apartment is the second unit in our two family home; we live upstairs and are available to assist guests as needed, but the apartment is completely separate, with private entrance for guests. 

The apartment has two bedrooms each with a queen bed and a common area combining the living room and kitchen. The kitchen is stocked with pots, pans, plates, glasses ect - everything needed for cooking and eating together as well as some basic spices, coffee, cream and sugar. 

It is a great apartment for two couples or a family. The couch can also be slept on, although it is in the common space. The deck is private, in the back-yard and is for exclusively for guests use - pretty perfect for hanging out before heading to dinner!

Guest access
Guests have full access to a private apartment with private entrance, deck and small yard. The apartment is the first floor of a two story two-family home, hosts live upstairs.

Please note that to access the apartment guests need to walk down an outdoor set of stone steps. If you have mobility concerns please review the photos carefully and reach out to us for more details or additional photos!

Other things to note
Our house (oddly) has two addresses, one on Sheridan Street for the owner unit and one on Marion Street for the airbnb apartment. We recommend parking on Sheridan street (more available, legal spaces) and walking down a short path to the lower unit door.

The apartment has a television with basic channels but is not hooked into a amazing array of subscriptions and channels.

Summer Guests: The apartment has 2 portable A/C units able to keep the temperature below 78 degrees typically and we provide fans, but have found that during heat waves (usually 3-6 days per summer) some guests are uncomfortable. If you require very controlled climates you may want to consider other listings or a hotel.

listings.description:
Beautifully appointed 1BR in Portland’s coveted East End. Just a short walk to the Eastern Prom and Old Port restaurants, shops, and waterfront. This first-floor apartment features a modern vibe, local artwork, Brooklinen linens, luxury towels, hotel-level cleanliness, and local coffee. Quiet owner-occupied building with private parking, shared outdoor patio, grill, and gas firepit. Queen bed + queen sleeper sofa. Non-smoking, no pets. Thoughtfully renovated with Off Street Parking

The space
As a frequent Airbnb guest myself — both in the U.S. and abroad — I’ve tried to create the kind of stay I personally appreciate: clean, comfortable, thoughtfully curated, and easy to settle into. My goal is for the apartment to feel welcoming and well cared for, with the comfort of a home and the consistency of a professionally managed stay. Cleanliness is a top priority, and much of the artwork throughout the space is by local Maine artists.

The East End is one of Portland’s most walkable and desirable neighborhoods — quiet, residential, and still just minutes from excellent restaurants, the waterfront, and the Old Port. The Eastern Prom and waterfront path are an easy walk away, and the city’s recently completed staircase offers quick access to the shoreline, walking paths, and beach area.

The apartment is located within an owner-occupied building with long-term residents, making it best suited for guests looking for a peaceful and respectful stay.

Cleaning fees go directly to my longtime housekeeper, whose consistency and attention to detail help make the apartment feel exceptionally clean and cared for. I’m very grateful for her work.

Guest access
You will have sole access to the apartment.

Other things to note
This apartment is located within a classic owner-occupied Portland building with long-term residents. While the apartment has been thoughtfully renovated and updated, the building itself reflects the character of an older East End property. Guests may occasionally hear normal residential living sounds. Quiet hours are respected and important to us.

The apartment was extensively refreshed and renovated in 2026, including updated windows and doors, refinished flooring, fresh paint, trim work, and updated interior finishes designed to create a clean, comfortable, and welcoming stay.

Welcome to a new place on the East End! A unique, modern guest house full of comforts, and yours to call home. Private and quiet, the rooms and kitchen fill with sunlight in the morning, and a high-efficiency heat pump provides upstairs A/C in the summers. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, and step outside the dining room onto the private patio. An ideal, walkable location--the guest house on Munjoy Hill is minutes away from the Eastern Promenade, the Old Port, and many excellent local spots.

The space
The Guest House was recently featured in Fine Homebuilding magazine for innovative approach to design, and construction for energy efficiency, in Dec/Jan 2026 "The Big Little House." 

"It's like around each corner, there is a new space that opens up." -Kavena

Our guests revel in a thoughtfully-designed guest house full of comforts and close to almost everything in town. Private and quiet, the rooms and kitchen fill with sunlight in the morning, and the living room fills with sun in the afternoon. Enjoy a modern, fully-equipped kitchen, and step outside from the dining room onto the private patio to enjoy a book and beverage, or prepare a meal on the grill. A high-efficiency heat pump provides climate control and upstairs A/C in the summers. Radiant floor heat warms the space and the bathroom tiles in the fall and winters.

On the second floor there are two bedrooms: one with a Queen Bed, and the second with a spacious and comfortable daybed, which extends to a Queen size, and sleeps two. Two separate bathrooms: one on each floor, with the upstairs featuring a full-tile shower. We also have amenities available for families traveling with kids, including an assortment of games, beach toys, and a small crib for little ones.

Boutique BnB in The Heart of Portland's East End offers a combination of rustic farmhouse charm with a vibrant contemporary, comfortable style.
Sunny, first floor apartment in an beautiful turn of the century Victorian building with private entrance, 2 plush queen beds, Art Deco bathroom with central kitchenette/dining room. This space is perfect for 2 couples or a small family. A short walk to gourmet restaurants, cafes, East End beach and all Portland peninsula has to offer!

The space
First floor with an easy keyless entry into a relaxing, homelike space with 2 luxury queen beds that is perfect to come home to after a day of exploring all that makes Portland, Maine such a perfect vacation destination!. This apartment's central area is a dining room/kitchenette with sink and mini-frige, with 2 burner stove for lite cooking, french press coffee maker, speed kettle, microwave, silverware and china. There is no “living room” area but the blue larger bedroom has a daybed, (good size for a child to sleep), and chair along with the queen bed for hanging out and watching TV (Netflix, Amazon Prime, Hulu). Complimentary local snacks, coffee, tea, and fruit for weary travelers,, wi-fi and plenty of suggestions for what to do and where to go to make the most of your stay! Free on-street parking, featuring art by some of Portland's most gifted artists.

Guest access
First floor private entrance #1, only 5 front stairs to first floor front apartment.This unit includes it's own bathroom with shower, a central dining room kitchen area and two bedrooms each with a queen bed. Down the gravel driveway there is a backyard for sitting in the sun, drinking your coffee and planning your adventures.

Other things to note
Please check out the online guidebook for this BnB here on the site! So many things to do, see, buy and adventures to go on, all with easy access. A small town with the food and culture of a bigger city and beaches to boot!

listings.title: Apartment in Portland
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Portland, Maine
listings.description:
The Mermaid Cove is a bright and airy two-bedroom apartment located in Portland’s historic West End. This large private apartment is serene, yet only a few minutes walk to the center of downtown and the Old Port. 

Each of the two separate bedrooms are outfitted with a queen-sized Casper mattress. With a fully stocked kitchen and bathroom, separate office nook, laundry, and off-street parking, The Mermaid Cove is an easy and convenient place to call home for your visit.

The space
The Mermaid Cove is located on a quiet street in Portland's beautiful West End, steps from some of the best restaurants and cafes. The large private apartment is within a historic building constructed in the 1800s, but has been fully updated with modern finishes and amenities. The space has a bright and open feel, with a large, well-stocked kitchen, comfortable living room, separate dining space, and office nook. 

Both bedrooms have queen sized beds with Casper memory foam mattresses, welcoming linens and blankets, and plenty of pillows. There is an awesome balcony off of one of the bedrooms that peaks at the Fore River and has a bistro set with seating for two. The bathroom is large and comfortable, with a deep tub and updated finishes. It also contains a full-sized washer/dryer set available for your use.

Wifi signal is strong throughout the apartment and the living room has an LED television with Netflix, Hulu, and Disney+ built in (local cable channels are also available).

Guest access
You have full and private access to the entire apartment. You'll check yourself into The Mermaid Cove with keypad locks.

listings.description:
Happy House, Urban Apartments is home to four bright, modern apartments inside a vintage building in the heart of Sangenjaya's lively streets. ✨
It's a 3-minute walk from Sangenjaya Station, and Shibuya is just 5 minutes by train. Restaurants, shops and bars are right outside. 🏠

This third-floor apartment features a stylish interior and a smart layout for two to five guests. Thoughtfully furnished, it's ideal for short city breaks and relaxed longer stays. Note: stairs only, no elevator. 😊

The space
Just a 3-minute walk from Sangenjaya Station and only two stops from Shibuya on the Den-en-toshi Line, our home is the perfect base for exploring Tokyo. 🚀

Enjoy modern design, high-quality comfort, and a lively neighborhood. Guests often tell us: "Even more spacious and comfortable than expected," "Fully equipped," "A very convenient location with plenty of shops," and "Fast Wi-Fi, perfect for longer stays." 🏠

The area is filled with excellent restaurants, stylish cafés, and everyday shops. We also provide a local food guide that our guests love. 🍷

From Happy House to:
- Sangenjaya Station (3 min walk)
- Shibuya Crossing (5 min by train)
- Gotokuji Temple, the "Lucky Cat Temple" (approx. 20 min by train)
- Shimokitazawa (approx. 15 min by bus)
- Nakameguro (approx. 15 min by bus)
- Harajuku (20 min by train)
- Meiji Shrine (20 min by train)
- Shinjuku Station (25 min by train)
- Tokyo Skytree (40 min by train)
- Asakusa (50 min by train)

Please feel free to contact us anytime with any questions or requests.

Guest access
Happy House Urban Apartments occupies the entire third floor of a lively vintage building, with four apartments: 301, 302, 303 and 305. 
Guests share the building's staircase, but each apartment has its own private entrance and is completely self-contained. 🌱

The ground floor is home to izakaya and restaurants that are popular across Tokyo, and on the second floor you'll find a café and a vintage clothing store. 🍺 ☕️ 👕

During your stay
We live just a few minutes' walk from Happy House and are always happy to help whenever needed. We respect your privacy and will never disturb you unnecessarily, so please feel completely at ease.

We're also happy to share our favorite local spots and recommendations. Our motto: "We want every guest to have a happy stay!" ☺️

Other things to note
🌟 A few notes for a comfortable stay 

▪ Stairs only 
No elevator, so it's stairs to the third floor. Heavy luggage can be a bit of a climb, but most guests say the location is worth it. Not ideal for guests with limited mobility.

▪ City sounds
You're in one of Tokyo's liveliest neighborhoods. Double-glazed windows keep things calm, but some street sounds may come through. Earplugs and a Bluetooth speaker are provided for added comfort.

▪ A vintage building with character
A retro building with a popular izakaya on the ground floor and a café on the second. Inside, your apartment is fully renovated, bright and modern.

listings.description:
Welcome to the SAIEI designer-style apartment located in Nishi-Shinjuku, a popular area of Tokyo.This place offers both the vibrant convenience of Shinjuku and a quiet, comfortable living environment. It is suitable for sightseeing, shopping, business trips, as well as for families, friends, or couples.

📍 Prime Location | An oasis in the city, ideal location

The home is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku 5-chome neighborhood, within walking distance to the station and shopping area:
・ 30 seconds walk: Drugstore and 24h convenience store
・1-minute walk: Large supermarket
・ There are plenty of restaurants nearby, as well as Japanese restaurants, coffee shops, and convenience stores.

🚃 Super convenient transportation | Easily explore Tokyo

🚉 2 stops, 4 minutes to the Shinjuku business district
✈️ 2 stops, 4 minutes to Shinjuku Airport Bus/Airport Express Train
🚃 Oedo Line provides direct access to popular areas such as Roppongi and Ueno

The space
💡 Room Features:
 
• 201: The largest space, suitable for families or guests who value private space. The living room offers a spacious and bright social area (equipped with two bathrooms and a bathtub). Can accommodate up to 8 guests.
• 202: Equipped with bunk beds, a boutique space for backpackers.
• Rooms on the 3rd to 5th floors: Recommended for 2–4 guests for a comfortable stay. Some rooms can accommodate up to 6 guests.
🌟 501: Features a separate workspace, suitable for families, digital nomads, and business travelers.
•🛁🚿 Some rooms feature two bathrooms, a bathtub, and a separate office space.
 
✨ Explore Tokyo with ease and return to a quiet residential neighborhood for a good rest.
⭐ SAIEI Select Configuration
 
🛏️ Comfortable sleep
 
• Double bed/Queen size bed/Bunk bed (depending on the room type)
• Some rooms have two bathrooms.
• Some rooms have a separate office space.
• Spacious and comfortable, suitable for both short and long stays
 
⸻
 
🧴 Quality amenities
 
• Japanese POLA brand toiletries
•  Private bathroom and bathtub (varies by room type)
•  Full set of basic toiletries
•  Professionally cleaned after each guest, so you can stay with peace of mind.
 
⸻
 
📺 Entertainment and household appliances
 
• Wi-Fi
• Smart TV (with access to personal accounts for Netflix, YouTube, etc.)
• Washing machine (washer-dryer combo)
•❄️ Air conditioning
• Refrigerator
•🍚 Rice cooker
• Microwave
• Water kettle
•💨 Hairdryer
• Fully equipped with basic household appliances
 
⚠️The Smart TV does not provide local Japanese digital TV channels. Please log out of your personal account before checking out.
 
⸻
 
🍳 Kitchen equipment
 
Suitable for everyday light cooking needs:
 
•  Frying pan, saucepan
•  Kitchen knife, kitchen scissors
•  Cutting board
• Cutlery, dishes, cups
•  Basic cooking utensils
 
⚠️ For reasons of hygiene, safety, and to avoid allergies, we do not provide laundry detergent, softener, or seasonings such as oil, salt, soy sauce, and pepper. If needed, you can buy them at a nearby convenience store or supermarket.
 
⸻
 
🏢 SAIEI Professional Services
 
•🔑Self Check-in
•📩 Detailed check-in instructions and door lock information sent via Airbnb before check-in
•💬 Online customer service team available to assist with check-in
•⚡ Quick responses during business hours
 
⸻
 
⚠️ House Rules
 
•️🛗 There is no elevator in this building, and all rooms are accessed via stairs.
• This property follows the traditional Japanese architectural structure and is designed to accommodate local walking habits, so there is no elevator. This is a common architectural feature of most Japanese houses and also reflects part of the local lifestyle and culture. We understand that this inconvenience may affect your stay, so we have sincerely reflected this condition in the price of the listing to offer a more competitive rate. Compared to listings with elevators in the same area, which are generally priced much higher, we hope to offer you a more affordable option that provides good value for money. Thank you for your understanding and support.
 
⸻
 
⏰ Check-in Time
 
•🕒 Check-in: 15:00–23:00 (Japan time)
•🔑Self Check-in
•📩 Detailed check-in instructions and door lock information will be sent through Airbnb before your stay.
•⏳ For early check-in or late check-out, please contact us at least 2-3 days in advance to confirm. We will do our best to help you based on the room availability on the day, the cleaning schedule, and subsequent booking arrangements.
•💴 If available, early check-in or late check-out is available at 2,000 yen per hour (less than 1 hour will be charged as 1 hour).

Guest access
🏠 Guests have exclusive use of the entire house, including all facilities and equipment inside.
 
Each listing has a private entrance, so you don't have to share living spaces such as the living room, kitchen, or bathroom with other guests during your stay, allowing you to enjoy a completely private accommodation experience.
 
The hallway, stairs, and building entrances are common areas for all guests. Please help keep the area clean and quiet. Thank you for your cooperation.

During your stay
To make your check-in process smoother, we offer online customer service.
 
🕙 Customer Service Hours: Daily from 10:00 to 23:00 (Japan Time)
 
If you have any questions, need help, or encounter any issues during your stay, please feel free to contact us anytime through the Airbnb platform.
 
📱 During business hours, our customer service team usually replies to your messages within 15 minutes and does its best to provide immediate assistance so you can enjoy your trip with peace of mind.

Other things to note
🧹 1. About cleaning and accommodation standards
 
We take the cleanliness and hygiene of the room seriously.
 
Before each guest checks in, the room is thoroughly cleaned and disinfected by a professional cleaner, and every effort is made to ensure that the room is clean, comfortable, and safe to use when you check in.
 
Please also understand that this property is a B&B/B&B-style apartment (not a traditional hotel), and its operating model and service approach are different from those of a hotel.Our service standard is "clean, hygienic, comfortable, and a stay with peace of mind." Thank you for your understanding.

⸻

 
🧳 2. Building layout and luggage storage instructions (please make sure you have checked)
 
The building where this listing is located has a total of 5 floors, and the rooms are located on the 2nd to 5th floors.
The property follows the traditional Japanese architecture and is in accordance with the local walking habits, so there is no elevator set up.This is a common architectural feature of most houses in Japan, and it also embodies a part of the local life culture.We understand that this inconvenience may affect your stay, so this condition is reflected in good faith in the room rate, providing a more competitive rate.Compared to homes with elevators in the same area, their pricing is much higher, and we hope to give you a better value for money stay with a more affordable option.Thanks for understanding and support.
 
❌ Luggage storage before check-in/after check-out
 
This property has an unattended self check-in method, so luggage storage is not available.For your convenience, there is a Coin Locker at the subway station near the house which is easy to use and is also suitable for storing luggage and valuables that you may use more.Your understanding and cooperation is appreciated.

⸻

 
🧼 3. Cleaning service and towel instructions
 
* There is no daily cleaning service during your stay.
* Towels and bath towels will be prepared according to the number of guests staying.
* 1 set of face and bath towels is provided per guest per stay.
 
In line with environmental protection and the way the B&B operates, there is no daily change service during your stay.
 
If you need to do laundry during your stay, there is a washing machine and dryer in the room for your use. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
 
⸻

⏰ 4. Check-in, Early Check-in and Late Check-out Information

Standard check-in time for this listing is 3:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m., and check-out time is 10:00 a.m.

If you expect to check in after 11:00 p.m., please be sure to contact us in advance via the booking platform to confirm, so we can inform you of the relevant check-in procedures and precautions in advance.

🧹 From 10:00 to 15:00 every day, our cleaning staff clean, disinfect and prepare the rooms for check-in, so early check-in and late check-out are subject to the day's check-out situation, cleaning progress and staff scheduling, and cannot be guaranteed in advance.

If you need to check in early or check out late, please request at least 1 day in advance, and we will confirm whether it can be arranged based on the actual situation on the day.

If we can confirm that it can be arranged, the following additional charges will apply:
・2,000 yen per hour
・Less than 1 hour is also charged as 1 hour, i.e., JPY 2,000.

For example, early check-in or late check-out of 30 minutes will also incur a charge of 2,000 yen.

Please understand that the relevant arrangements must be made on the premise that they do not affect the check-out of the previous group of guests, the thorough cleaning and disinfection of the room, and the normal check-in of the next group of guests. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

⸻
 
🚫 V. Description of items not provided
 
For hygiene, safety, and allergy risk reasons, the following items are not provided at this property:
 
* Bottled drinking water
* Laundry detergent (some customers may be allergic to ingredients, please prepare your own)
* Condiments (e.g. cooking oil, salt, pepper, sugar etc)
* International Adaptor
 
⸻
 
🚗 6. Airport pick-up/drop-off service information
 
Airport pickup and drop off service is paid separately and is not a free item.
 
The actual cost will vary depending on the pickup time, number of passengers and number of luggage.
 
Please contact us at least 3 days in advance to confirm if you wish to do so. Whether it can be arranged will depend on the actual situation.
 
⸻
 
🏠 7. Check-in conduct and house rules (including instructions for handling violations)
 
For the safety of the home's amenities and the neighborhood, we ask that you follow the following rules of use during your stay:
 
*❌ Unregistered guests are not allowed to enter the property.
Any unauthorized bringing in unregistered persons may be asked to end their stay early without any refund.
*🐾 No pets are allowed in this property.
If pets are found to be brought into the property, they may be asked to process immediately or end the stay early, and will incur a corresponding cleaning and recovery fee.
*👟 Please take off your shoes before entering the house.
We have prepared indoor slippers for you, please cooperate to keep the house clean together.
*🚭 No smoking inside the property or in the building's common areas.
If smoking is detected indoors or in common areas, a fee of JPY 30,000 will be charged for cleaning, deodorizing, and related handling.
*🔑 Please keep the room key safe.
If the key is lost or cannot be returned, a fee of JPY 20,000 will be charged to cover the cost of replacing the lock and making a new key.
 
All of these fees are the actual processing and restoration costs incurred and are not punitive charges.
 
We understand and cooperate with you in case of non-compliance through the booking platform.
 
⸻
 
🚽 8. Bathroom Usage Instructions (including blockage handling fees)
 
To avoid damage to your equipment and impact your subsequent use, please be sure to take note of the following when using the toilet:
 
*🚫 Please do not flush anything other than toilet paper down the toilet.
(Such as wipes, facial tissues, feminine hygiene products, plastics, etc.)
*⚠️ If the toilet becomes clogged or requires professional unclogging due to items other than toilet paper being flushed, a fee of JPY 30,000 will be charged to cover unclogging, repairs, and related handling costs.
 
The above fees are both the actual cost of repairs and processing and are not punitive charges.
 
We understand and cooperate with you in communicating and processing through the booking platform in the event of a related situation.
 
⸻
 
🗑 9. Waste sorting instructions
 
Japan has strict rules on sorting garbage.
 
There are already separate bins in the house, please tie the trash bag tightly and place it in the designated large trash can, which will be taken care of by the cleaners.
 
Your understanding and cooperation is appreciated.
 
⸻
 
🔇 10. Noise and Neighborhood Relations
 
This is located in a residential area and we ask that you be mindful of the volume control during your stay.
 
Please avoid loud noises, gatherings, or sound equipment at night to avoid affecting the neighbors.
 
Please understand that we may ask you to end your stay early in case of a neighbor's complaint or police intervention due to noise issues.
 
⸻
 
 11. Check-in registration and legal requirements (Important)
 
In accordance with the Japanese Private Lodging Business Law and related regulations, all guests staying in the property are required to complete the check-in registration and provide the following information:
 
* Name, gender, address, nationality
* Passport numbers
* A clear picture of the full passport information page
* A photo that clearly shows my face and passport (for identity confirmation)
 
If you have a residential address in Japan, you will also need to provide a photo of your Residence Card, driver's license, or My Number Card.
 
⚠️ If you are unable to provide the above information as required, we will not be able to check you in. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
 
🌿 About the space and the stay
 
Central Tokyo has limited land resources, and accommodations with elevators are usually smaller and relatively high room rates.
 
The home features a general Japanese home layout, and although there is no elevator set up, it provides a more spacious and comfortable living space, and is well balanced between the quality of the accommodation, the size of the room, and the price, so it is also loved by many families and group travelers.
 
Thank you for your understanding and support, and we look forward to making your stay comfortable, restful, and enjoyable.✨
 
⸻
 
✅ Final reminder
 
These are all clearly stated on your listing page and in your check-in instructions, and we'd appreciate it if you'd like to review and confirm before you book.
 
If you have higher traditional hotel-like expectations for accommodation conditions or service modes, we recommend that you choose a hotel stay that better meets your needs for a more expected check-in experience.
 
If you have confirmed and understood the form of accommodation in this property, we will sincerely welcome you to your stay and look forward to providing you with a peaceful, comfortable and enjoyable stay in Tokyo.🌿

A brand new condo dedicated to providing you with a comfortable and convenient accommodation experience for your trip to Tokyo, so that you can feel at home during your trip.The accommodation has fully equipped living facilities and is perfect for sightseeing, shopping and business travelers.

The apartment is located in Ueno, Taito-ku, Tokyo. It is about a 5-minute walk to Inaricho Station, where you can take the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line directly to Asakusa, Ginza, and Shibuya. It is about a 7-minute walk to Ueno Station.Ueno Station is one of the major transportation hubs in Tokyo, with access to multiple JR lines, the subway, and the Shinkansen, making it very convenient to get to central Tokyo and other areas.

The National Museum of Western Art and Ueno Onshi Park are about a 15-minute walk from the apartment. There are plenty of convenience stores, restaurants, and other amenities nearby.There is a paid parking lot about 2 minutes on foot from the apartment, making it very convenient for self-driving guests.

Starting from Ueno Station, the approximate times to major areas are as follows: Akihabara about 3 minutes, Asakusa about 8 minutes, Ginza about 11 minutes, Ikebukuro about 16 minutes, Shinjuku about 25 minutes, and Shibuya about 28 minutes.
