listings.description:
👏A Cozy Private Ground Floor Retreat in a Quiet Sumida Neighborhood | Bunk Beds for 2 | Near Asakusa & Tokyo Skytree

A premium Japanese-Western fusion apartment nestled in the heart of Oshiage, just a 4-minute walk from Oshiage Station and Tokyo Skytree, and a 10-minute walk from Senso-ji Temple.

Oshiage is a unique neighborhood in Tokyo where modern energy meets traditional charm.

The space
With Tokyo Skytree and its vibrant shopping and dining scene nearby, while historic Asakusa is just a short stroll away, it offers the perfect balance of contemporary convenience and authentic Tokyo atmosphere.

🏡Location:Sumida, Tokyo | Quiet street corner | Japanese-Western fusion style | 3 Bedrooms, 2 Bathrooms | Near Asakusa & Tokyo Skytree

Tucked away in a quiet corner of the bustling city, this serene little apartment feels like a private escape just for you. Step inside and discover your own peaceful sanctuary in the heart of Tokyo.

💡Highlights
✔Free Luggage Storage
Arriving early or checking out late? No need to drag your bags around.

Our building offers a complimentary luggage room for guests, allowing you to explore the city freely until the last moment.

✅Enjoy high-quality Japanese POLA toiletries, custom bedding, and ergonomically designed comfortable mattresses.
✅Fully equipped kitchen with cookware and tableware for simple homemade meals.
✅Amenities include washing machine, dryer, hairdryer, iron, desk, and microwave.
Excellent Transportation & Accessibility
👍￼Convenient subway access just a 4-minute walk away.
￼#Only 4 minutes walk to Tokyo Skytree, Solamachi Shopping Mall, and large supermarkets; dining and shopping are all nearby.
￼#15 minutes to Shinjuku by subway—explore nightlife, fashion, and unique Japanese souvenirs.
￼#32 minutes to Shibuya by train—immerse yourself in Tokyo’s youthful culture.
￼#50 minutes to Yokohama by train—enjoy seaside views and city lights.
￼#Detailed sightseeing guides available upon request.
Nearby Convenience
￼24-hour convenience store within a 1-minute walk.
￼Drugstore just 3 minutes away.

🛏️ Room Layout
￼Two single bunk beds (2m × 1m each), perfect for friends or travel companions seeking comfort and privacy

￼Open kitchen with basic cooking utensils, ideal for preparing a simple homemade meal
￼
⚠️ Please note: To prevent allergies or odors, no seasonings or condiments are provided—guests are welcome to bring their own

🛁 Bathroom & Laundry

￼✅Separate wet and dry areas keep the bathroom clean and fresh
 ✅Basic toiletries included: disposable toothbrush, hairdryer, etc.
￼✅Washer with dryer function, perfect for business travelers or long stays

Additional Information:

🤫Quiet Environment:Nestled in a peaceful residential area near Tokyo Skytree

🅿️Parking:24-hour parking nearby with affordable overnight rates
💬 Quality Online Host Service

To give you privacy and a home-like retreat experience, this accommodation is a self-check-in style Airbnb. However, our online hosts are available in real time from 10:00 to 23:00 (Tokyo time) to support you, ensuring a high-quality stay. 🕙

Other Things to Note

🧼 SAIEI's Cleaning Standards

We place great importance on cleanliness and hygiene of the room 🧹

Before each guest's arrival, the room is thoroughly cleaned and disinfected by professional cleaners. We do our best to ensure the room is clean, comfortable, and ready for your peace of mind upon check-in. ✅

Our management and cleaning standards aim for "clean, hygienic, comfortable, and worry-free."

Luggage Storage:
￼Available on the 3rd floor, unattended; CCTV monitored
￼Bring valuables with you; lost/damaged items not covered
￼Coin lockers at nearby stations are recommended for valuables

🧺 III. Cleaning Service & Towels
- 🧽 Cleaning service will be rendered upon special request with a charge per service during your stay
- 🧴 Towels and bath towels are provided according to the number of guests
If you need any washing & refreshing during your stay, a washer-dryer is available in the room. Thank you for your understanding. 🙏
🚫 IV. Items Not Provided In the Room:
- 🚱 Bottled drinking water
- 🧴 Laundry detergent (for allergic reasons)
- 🧂 Seasonings (e.g., oil, salt, pepper, sugar)
- 🔌 International adaptor

✈️ V. Airport Transfer Service
If airport pick-up or send-off is needed, please contact us at least 3 days in advance to inquire about details, including the fee. (Arrangements are subject to availability)

*Kind reminder: The fee varies depending on pickup time, number of passengers, and luggage volume.* 🚖

Other things to note
📜 VI. House Rules (Including Violation & Outcomes)
To protect the property and maintain good relations with neighbors, please follow these rules throughout your stay:

❌ No unregistered guests – Bringing unregistered individuals into the property may result in early termination of your stay without a refund.
🐾 No pets – If a pet is found on the premises, you may be asked to address the situation immediately or check out early. Cleaning and restoration fees will also apply.
👟 Please remove shoes indoors – Indoor slippers are provided. Thank you for helping us keep the space clean.
🚭 No smoking inside the property or building – A ¥30,000 cleaning and deodorizing fee will apply.
🔑 Please take care of the door key – If the key is lost or cannot be returned, a ¥20,000 replacement fee will apply.

These fees reflect actual handling and restoration costs—they are not penalties. Any violations will be addressed through the booking platform. Thank you for your understanding. 🙇

🚽 VII. Tips on Proper Toilet Use in Japan (Including Clogging Fee)
To avoid any damage and ensure proper use, please kindly follow these guidelines:
- 🧻 Avoid flushing down anything other than toilet paper (e.g., wet wipes, tissues, sanitary products, plastic items)
- 💸 If a clogging occurs and causes professional repair service, an extra maintenance fee of ¥30,000 will apply to cover actual repair and serving costs. Payment transfer will be handled through the booking platform. Thank you for your understanding.

🗑️ VIII. Garbage Sorting
Japan enforces strict regulations on garbage sorting. ♻️

Separated bins are provided in the room for your convenience. Please seal your garbage bags and place them in the designated large trash bin when they are full, where our cleaning staff will take care of the rest.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. 🙏

🔇 IX. Noise & Neighborly Relations

This property is located in a quiet residential area. Please be mindful of noise levels throughout your stay and avoid loud sounds from any source. 🤫
Under local administrative regulations, if a legitimate complaint is received from neighbors—or if the situation escalates to the point of police involvement—guests may be required to check out immediately upon the verified report. In such cases, no refund will be issued. ⚠️

📋 X. Registration & Legal Compliance (Important)⚖️
Under Japan's *Private Lodging Act*, every registered guest is required to provide the following information to complete check-in registration:

- 📝 Name, gender, address, nationality
- 🛂 Passport number
- 📄 Clear full-page photo of your passport
- 📸 A photo showing your face alongside your passport (for identity verification)

For anyone who has a residential address in Japan, a copy of your Residence Card / Driver's License / My Number Card is acceptable as an alternative.

⚠️Please note that the passport registration process is essential; we are not allowed to proceed with providing accommodation in accordance with local stipulations if the information listed above is not provided. Thank you for your understanding. 🙇

listings.title: Rental unit in Taitō-ku
listings.headline: Rental unit in Taitō-ku, Japan
listings.description:
From the rooftop, you can see Skytree and the Sumida River, and you may be able to see fireworks. It is a five-story apartment building with automatic locks, an elevator, and a total of 13 rooms. You can use five stations: about 3 minutes on foot (240 m) from Exit A2b of Asakusa Station on the Toei Subway, about 4 minutes (320 m) from Exit A3 of Asakusa Station on the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, about 6 minutes (480 m) from Exit A7 of Kuramae Station on the Toei Subway Oedo Line, about 8 minutes on foot from Asakusa Station on the Tobu Isesaki Line, and about 15 minutes on foot from Asakusa Station on the Tsukuba Express. Asakusa Station is nearby, and there is great access not only to Narita Airport and Haneda Airport, but also to Nikko, Tsukuba, and other areas. It is also convenient for Ueno, Ginza, Akihabara, Shinjuku, and Shibuya. There are convenience stores, mini supermarkets, various shops, commercial facilities, and restaurants in the area. The bus stop is a 3-minute walk away, and the water bus stop is an 8-minute walk away. Senso-ji Temple, Kaminarimon gate, the Five-Storied Pagoda, Nakamise shopping Street, the water bus, and the Gohabashi Shopping Arcade are all within a 10-minute walk, and Sumida Park is about an 8-minute walk away.

The space
The rooftop overlooks Tokyo Skytree and the Sumida River, and the view is stunning. The building is an apartment with an automatic lock.

During your stay
If there is a problem during your stay, we will not be able to respond immediately, but we will do our best to assist you via email. Quiet hours are from 11 pm to 9 am Japan time.

Other things to note
There are five stations and many bus stops around our inn, making it convenient to get to any venue. The stations you can use are Toei Asakusa line Asakusa station (about 3 minutes/240 m on foot from Exit A2b), Tokyo Metro Ginza line Asakusa station (about 4 minutes/320 m from Exit A3), Toei Oedo line Kuramae station (about 6 minutes/480 m from Exit A7), Tobu Isesaki line Asakusa station (about 8 minutes on foot), and Tsukuba Express Asakusa station (about 15 minutes on foot). It is also about a 3-minute walk (210 m) to the bus stop for Tokyo Station. In accordance with the law, when you check in, we will record guest information such as name, address, occupation, and nationality. In addition, guests who live outside of Japan are asked to present their passports, and a copy of them will be kept for recording purposes. If you live in Japan, regardless of your nationality, be sure to show your ID issued in Japan (for example, a residential card, alien registration card, driver's license) to confirm your domestic residence, so that your host understands that you aren't required to show your passport as well.

listings.name: Refined Design, Bright & Quiet, Near Tokyo Tower
listings.title: Rental unit in Minato-ku
listings.headline: Rental unit in Minato-ku, Japan
listings.description:
Set on a quiet back street in a refined residential area, LiveGRACE Azabu is an apartment hotel near Tokyo Tower, Shiba Park, and Zojoji Temple. Tokyo Tower is a 6-minute walk away, Akabanebashi Station is 5 minutes on foot, and supermarkets, convenience stores, drugstores, restaurants, cafés, and bars are all within a 10-minute walk. With one private suite per floor, the building offers a calm and private base for exploring Tokyo.

The space
LiveGRACE Azabu is a six-story apartment hotel with an elevator and five private suites, with one suite on each floor from the 2F to the 6F.

Each suite is fully self-contained and occupies its own floor, with a private entrance door and no other guest rooms on the same level. This one-suite-per-floor layout creates a quieter stay with a greater sense of privacy. Guests may reserve an individual suite or, when available, book the entire building for private use of all five suites and the shared 1F facilities.

The 2F–4F suites are approximately 35㎡ and include a separate bedroom, living room, kitchenette, and a Japanese-style sitting area by the window. These suites are well suited to couples, small families, or guests who prefer more space for relaxing, working, or longer stays.

The 5F suite is approximately 33㎡ and features a separate bedroom and a tatami living area. The tatami space can be used as a calm sitting area during the day and can also accommodate Japanese futons when needed.

The 6F suite is a compact 13㎡ top-floor studio. It has a sofa bed, a small work area by the window, and a compact food-preparation area. Unlike the other suites, its private bathroom includes a bathtub.

For full details on the layout, sleeping arrangements, and amenities of each unit, please refer to the individual suite description.

Guest access
Guests have private access to the suite they reserved, together with the building’s shared entrance, elevator, lobby lounge, and 1F laundry room.

Each suite has its own entrance and is used only by the guests who booked that unit. Inside, guests can enjoy a private sleeping and living space, bathroom, Wi-Fi, climate control, and a compact kitchenette or food-preparation area with essential appliances. The shared laundry room on the 1F is equipped with washing and drying facilities for guest use.

If you book the entire building, you will have access to all five private suites from the 2F to 6F, as well as all shared facilities on the 1F.

For the exact layout, sleeping arrangements, and full list of amenities, please refer to the description for each individual suite.

During your stay
We will contact you via Airbnb before arrival and greet you in person to help ensure a smooth check-in. We enjoy meeting guests and are happy to share our local favorites, experiences, and dining recommendations.
During your stay, you can reach us through Airbnb messages, phone, or LINE. For prompt responses, we highly recommend keeping the Airbnb app accessible on your phone.

Other things to note
- Please keep noise low in shared areas, including the entrance, lobby lounge, elevator, and hallways.
- The windows have safety locks and cannot be fully opened.
- No cleaning service is provided during your stay. Additional cleaning can be arranged for an extra fee.
- Towels and bedding are prepared before check-in and are not replaced during your stay. Extra towels or linen changes can be arranged for an additional fee.
- Toilet paper, tissues, paper towels, and toiletries are provided at check-in and are not refilled during your stay.
- We do not provide disposable items such as toothbrushes and toothpaste.
- Please do not drag heavy items or luggage across the wooden floors.
- Please handle the sliding doors and tatami areas gently to avoid damage.
- Additional cleaning fees may apply if stains are left on the tatami.

listings.name: History and Comfort at Roma Norte
listings.title: Apartment in Roma Norte
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Roma Norte, Mexico
listings.description:
Step into a piece of Mexico's architectural history. This spacious two-bedroom apartment boasts original mid-century furniture, including pieces by renowned architects like Alejandro Escudero and Mario Pani. Immerse yourself in the charm of a bygone era with all the modern comforts you need.

The space
Immerse yourself in the history of Mexico City by staying in the iconic Witches' Building. Built in 1908 by British engineer R. A. Pigenon and remodeled 1942 in Art Deco style by Mexican architect Francisco Serrano, this place is a true historical gem.

This spacious two-bedroom apartment offers a unique experience. Original mid-century furniture, including pieces by Alejandro Escudero, the famous Mexican architect Mario Pani, and more from this private collection, transport you to an era of elegance and romance. At the heart of the building you'll find a fully equipped kitchen ready to meet your culinary needs.

Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms provide comfort and privacy for four people. Enjoy the panoramic view of the square, especially from the charming terrace.

Our commitment is to offer you not only a stay, but an immersion in the historical charm of Mexico City. Experience the fusion of past and present in this space that invites you to explore. Plus, thanks to the wealth of businesses such as supermarkets, organic stores, bakeries, boutiques, cafes, fashion shops, and artisans in the area, you'll have everything you need just steps away.

Guest access
At Edificio de las Brujas, guests access a space that seamlessly blends history with comfort. From the entrance, they immerse themselves in the unique atmosphere of this iconic building. They will enjoy cozy common areas and a terrace with charming views. The apartment offers two bedrooms, two well-equipped bathrooms, and a complete kitchen. The living room is a perfect corner to unwind. Here, Mexico City is experienced at its finest.

Other things to note
Our rooms are deep cleaned between each guest to give you peace of mind when you arrive. Should you wish to have your room cleaned during your stay, please let us know, and we can provide the service free of charge.

Upon arrival, we can provide tips for which restaurants, coffee shops and activities you should see/do in the area as well as how to stay safe in Mexico City during the pandemic. 

At the moment, we are not offering any culinary services.

Modern, cozy loft with a balcony, just one block from Paseo de la Reforma, between Zona Rosa and Glorieta del Ahuehuete. Enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and easy access to the Angel of Independence, Chapultepec, Roma, and Condesa. A futon converts into a bed for a third guest. Located in one of Mexico City’s safest areas. Some nighttime noise may occur due to nearby bars and restaurants.

The space
Comfortable 45 m² loft, thoughtfully designed to make your stay comfortable and enjoyable. It features a fully equipped kitchen, a modern bathroom, and elevator access. The building dates back to 1975, was renovated in the 1990s, and is in excellent condition. The apartment was completely remodeled in 2024.

Relax on the private balcony overlooking charming Copenhagen Street, one of the neighborhood’s most picturesque streets, lined with cafés, restaurants, and bars. Just one block from Paseo de la Reforma, you’ll be in an unbeatable location to explore the very best of Mexico City.

For added peace of mind and security, the third-floor lobby is monitored by a 24/7 security camera.

Guest access
Guests enjoy a private, self-check-in experience using a secure lockbox located outside the building, making it easy to arrive at any time, even late at night. Detailed check-in instructions are sent the day before arrival. If you prefer, we’re also happy to welcome you in person—just let us know your exact arrival time in advance. The building has both an elevator and stairs, but please note that it does not have a front desk or doorman.

listings.name: Hipódromo Studio, Workspace & Steps to Metro
listings.title: Apartment in Mexico City
listings.headline: Entire rental unit in Mexico City, Mexico
listings.description:
Third-floor studio in Hipódromo with 100 Mbps internet, dedicated workspace, and luggage lockers for flexible check-in. Metro Patriotismo is a 5-minute walk; OXXO, supermarkets, and local markets sit directly across the street. Private bathroom, electric cooktop, and French press included. Designed for remote workers and travelers who want walkable streets, local cafes, and simple metro access to explore Mexico City.

The space
This private studio in Hipódromo-Condesa sleeps two and puts you steps from Metro Patriotismo, cafés, and some of Mexico City's best restaurants. The biggest draw? A dedicated workspace with fast Wi-Fi (100 Mbps) that makes remote work feel effortless, all in one of the city's most walkable and vibrant neighborhoods.

- Bedrooms & Bathrooms
The studio centers around a comfortable double bed with room-darkening shades and a mosquito net for restful sleep. The private bathroom includes hot water, a hair dryer, and essentials like shampoo and conditioner. Portable fans keep the space comfortable year-round.

- Living, Dining & Kitchen
The kitchenette gives you everything to prepare meals at home: mini fridge, microwave, electric cooktop, French press, and a full set of cookware and wine glasses. A dining table doubles as extra workspace, and the smart TV is ready when you want to wind down after exploring the neighborhood.

- Good To Know
Fast 100 Mbps Wi-Fi and a dedicated desk make this an excellent base for remote work or extended stays. Secure lockers let you store luggage before 2:00 pm check-in or after 10:00 am check-out. Supermarkets, local markets, and an OXXO are right across the street. The studio is on the third floor with no elevator, so plan accordingly if you're traveling with heavy bags. Weekly cleaning is included for longer stays upon request.

Guest access
Access is fully self check-in through electronic locks on both the building entrance and the apartment door, allowing a convenient arrival at any time, 24 hours a day.

You may enter the building at any time. If you arrive before check-in, you can use the lockers to store your luggage.

The apartment may still be occupied until check-in time, so we kindly ask that you do not knock or attempt to enter before the agreed time.

The building has security cameras, and the area is safe. 

Self check-in instructions and access codes will be sent two days before your arrival.

Other things to note
• Great location with supermarkets, local markets, and an OXXO convenience store right in front of the building.

• The kitchenette includes basic equipment for cooking, including a mini fridge, microwave, electric cooktop, cookware, dishes, wine glasses, and more.

• High-speed internet (100 Mbps).

• There may be some construction noise during the day. It is occasional and not very loud, but we prefer to mention it in advance.

• The building does not have an elevator, and the apartment is located on the third floor (three levels above ground level).

• For long stays, weekly cleaning is included upon request.

• Lockers are available to store luggage before check-in (2:00 pm) or after check-out (10:00 am).

• A few kitchen utensils are available for your use if needed. You can find them stored in the lockers.
